articleTitle: A Method for Suppressing Torque Ripple of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor by Harmonic Injection Considering Loss Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) are widely used, but they suffer from torque ripple issues, which can be effectively mitigated through the harmonic injection method of the control strategy. Currently, harmonic injection methods for suppressing torque ripple often compromise the thermal performance of PMSMs, leading to increased losses. Therefore, this paper establishes a model that includes copper loss and iron loss as constraints and proposes a harmonic injection algorithm that incorporates these loss constraints. Furthermore, the motor is simulated and verified at a rated speed of 1200 rpm and an overspeed of 1500 rpm. The results demonstrate that the proposed method can suppress both torque ripple and losses. The torque ripple of the PMSM is reduced by more than 38.86%, the total harmonic distortion (THD) is reduced by approximately 29.01%, and the losses are reduced by more than 30.27%. This method has a small computational complexity and simple implementation. It can reduce losses and improve current waveform while suppressing torque ripple.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction Hybrid Model of Lithium-ion Battery Based on Improved GWO-LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries, as the core of new energy vehicles, determine the safety of new energy vehicles. Remaining useful life of the battery is the most important parameter, and it is particularly important to estimate the remaining life accurately. This paper proposes a hybrid algorithm of GWO algorithm and LightGBM algorithm based on improved convergence factor and proportional weights, which is used to predict the remaining life of lithium-ion batteries. It is verified by using NASA data set, which proves that the optimization of GWO algorithm can significantly improve LightGBM algorithm. RMSE, MAE and MAPE increased by $71.46 \%, 80.59 \%$ and 75.79% respectively.

articleTitle: Rule-based Energy Management Strategy for Fuel Cell Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of non-reversible recovery of electric energy and weak dynamic characteristics of fuel single fuel cell vehicles, this paper uses a power cell and a fuel cell to form a hybrid power system, and through the use of the power-following energy management strategy, the excellent dynamic performance of the power cell is utilized to compensate for the output of the fuel cell, so as to reduce the fluctuation of the output power of the fuel cell, and the strategy can achieve the maintenance of the power cell’s. This strategy can maintain the State of Charge of the power battery and prevent the battery from overcharging or over discharging. Through simulation analysis, this strategy can effectively maintain the stability of the battery State of Charge. The energy management strategy based on power following control proposed in this study provides a practical solution for the efficient and environmentally friendly operation of hybrid-driven fuel cell vehicles.

articleTitle: A Suboptimal Interception Guidance Law Based on Event-Triggered Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: To conserve computing and communication resources in missile control systems, the finite-time differential game interception problem is addressed using the event-triggered mechanism. Firstly, the maneuvering target interception issue is converted into the nonlinear zero-sum differential game with impact time constraints. Secondly, by integrating the event-triggering mechanism with the state-dependent differential Riccati equation, the task of solving the Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs equation is reformulated as solving the event-triggered state-dependent Riccati equation. Subsequently, a suboptimal guidance strategy is developed, along with the design of the event-triggered condition. The stability of the nonlinear system is proven through Lyapunov theory. Additionally, the theoretical minimum triggering interval is calculated to eliminate Zeno behavior. Finally, two experiments are designed to illustrate the superiority of the proposed guidance law.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle User Profiling and Spatiotemporal Charging Demand Forecasting Based on Monte Carlo Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of limited understanding of current user behaviors by proposing an electric vehicle (EV) user profile method that encompasses a broad distribution range, large quantity, and diverse scale features. With the Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM), the study categorizes EV users into 7 classes. Subsequently, employing kernel density estimation, we construct probability density functions(PDF) and perform Monte Carlo simulations to predict EV charging demands. This theoretical framework establishes a foundation for future advancements in managing and scheduling EV charging and discharging operations, aiming to optimize energy usage and improve overall system efficiency.

articleTitle: New View Synthesis via Multiscale-depth and Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: New View Synthesis is a challenging task that involves generating images similar to target views by reasoning about unknown perspectives based on known views. Traditional image-based rendering methods often suffer from poor quality with sparse input views. We propose a novel approach that embeds attention mechanisms into a convolutional network for encoding and decoding. This method can reason about views and corresponding 3D representations using only a monocular 2D image and its camera pose. Our encoder utilizes a multilevel, multi-branch structural unit to capture features at different scales. Additionally, the joint attention mechanism (ECAnet) adaptively adjusts channel weights, improving network performance without explicit 3D supervision. The end-to-end trainable network presented in this paper does not suffer from distortions in both object-oriented and scene-oriented, enabling synthesis of new views with higher perceptual quality.

articleTitle: Midcourse Guidance Trajectory Planning Method Based on Pseudospectral Sequence Convex Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: A method of course planning based on pseudospectral sequence convex programming is proposed to address the issues of slow generation speed, poor trapezoidal discrete fitting accuracy and the lack of a solution to strong equality terminal constraints in fixed time. This paper employs convex programming theory to enhance the efficiency of model solving and variable trust region to reduce the number of iterations. The model is discretized using the pseudo-spectrum method. A relaxation method for terminal constraints is proposed to relax strong equality constraints and constrain them in the performance index, thus ensuring that the trajectory can be generated quickly. The simulation outcomes reveal that the presented approach is capable of swiftly generating midcourse guidance trajectories that adhere to various constraints.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Gas-solid Coupling in Garbage Pneumatic Conveying System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: This paper employs the CFD-DEM gas-solid coupling simulation to investigate the distribution strategy of forming the airflow velocity in the pipeline of the garbage pneumatic conveying system (GPCS), aiming to achieve smooth transportation with minimum energy consumption. Numerical simulation is conducted specifically for the GPCS in SinoSingapore Tianjin Eco-City. The detailed analysis on the transportation characteristics of garbage particles with volumes ranging from 1 to 10 L and densities varying from 200 to 1200 $\mathrm{kg} / \mathrm{m}^{3}$ have been performed. The key parameters including solid-to-gas ratio and corresponding dynamic pressure for the transportation have been obtained based on the simulation results. Moreover, it is concluded that the volume of waste particles has a significant impact on the conveying air velocity, while the density has a relatively minor influence. Therefore, the conveying air velocity of the pneumatic transportation system can be determined based on the volume of waste particles. To verify the feasibility of the proposed simulation method, the real dynamic pressure and corresponding airflow velocity of the GPCS have been acquired with the fan frequency ranging from 1 Hz to 45 Hz. The error standard deviation of the airflow velocity between the simulated data and the calculate acquired data was $0.1277 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}$. Experimental results proved that the proposed simulation method is capable of providing the effective airflow deployment strategy in the GPCS.

articleTitle: A Post-event Distribution Network Restoration Approach Considering Network Reconfiguration and Mobile Emergency Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Given that frequent extreme events cause severe damage to the distribution network, this paper proposes a post-event recovery methodology that takes into account network reconfiguration and the deployment of mobile emergency generators. The aim is to effectively mitigate the damage caused by such events. Firstly, a disaster recovery model for the distribution network is established, focusing on the optimal coordination of mobile emergency generator dispatch and network reconfiguration. The primary optimization objective is to minimize load loss within the distribution network. In the pre-event phase, mobile emergency generators are strategically pre-positioned. During the fault isolation stage, these pre-positioned generators are rapidly deployed in coordination with network reconfiguration efforts, forming restorative islands. This approach can greatly improve the emergency response ability of the distribution network. To validate the efficacy of the presented approach, an IEEE 33-node power distribution system is used. The results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the method in improving the recovery of power distribution networks during extremely events.

articleTitle: Tactical Analysis and Defense Strategy Assessment of the Saudi Attack Incident Based on Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Focusing on the September 2019 attack on Saudi Arabian oil facilities, this study examines the contextual background and associated intelligence. It scrutinizes the deployment status of Saudi air defense systems at that time and systematically constructs operational sequences for both drone assaults and cruise missile strikes. Utilizing simulation, the study uncovers the Saudi air defense system’s shortcomings in detecting low-altitude small targets and its interception capabilities. The integration of domestically produced, export-oriented F-2 and F-3 weapon systems is proposed to bolster defenses against drone swarms and cruise missiles. Subsequent simulation confirm the efficacy of the enhanced defense strategy. Furthermore, it posits that with the proliferation of swarm and salvo tactics, the development trajectory of air defense weaponry will favor low-cost systems with large munition capacities.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Portable Electrochemiluminescence Detection System Based on Phytium Pi
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: This study presents a portable detection device that utilizes the principle of electrochemiluminescence (ECL). The device uses a lithium battery as the electrode excitation source. And the paper-based three electrodes is used as the solution carrier. The image is captured by an embedded camera and processed on a Phytium Pi development version. All above are in the dark room which is completed using 3D printing technology. The user interface of the software is developed using PyQt5 on the Debian system. Additionally, the software includes modules for camera drivers, image acquisition, and preprocessing based on OpenCV. The data validity is detected in real-time using the MobileNetv2 network. The design method can detect melamine concentrations ranging from $10^{-3} \mathrm{~mol} / \mathrm{L}$ to $10^{-8} \mathrm{~mol} / \mathrm{L}$. This method is significant for the application of ECL detection technology, as it allows for the detection of various substances by prefabricating different calibration curves. It has high potential for widespread use.

articleTitle: A Method for Allocating Hybrid Teaching Credit Hours Using Hierarchical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Hybrid teaching combines traditional teaching and flipped classroom, which is a new teaching mode with the advantages of both modes. In hybrid teaching mode, reasonable allocation of credit hours between traditional teaching and flipped classroom is an important issue for the teaching work. This paper first proposes a method of using hierarchical analysis to allocate credit hours for hybrid teaching of Digital Electronic Technology courses. Firstly, we divided hybrid teaching into stage and content layers, and determined the various elements of stage and content layers. Secondly, the requirements of the Analytic Hierarchy Process were applied to organize these two levels, and pairwise importance comparisons were made for each element within the level. Index judgment matrices were established for the stage level and content level, respectively. Then, the calculation steps of the Analytic Hierarchy Process were designed, and matrix operations were used to obtain the normalized weights of each element in the stage and content layers of traditional teaching and flipped classrooms. This weight was used to determine the class hours to be allocated for each stage and content. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper were verified using the example of hybrid teaching hour allocation in Chapter 4 of the Digital Electronic Technology course at Tianjin University of Technology.

articleTitle: An Evolution Model of Network Public Opinion Based on the Integration of Opinion Dynamics and Catastrophe Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the popularization of the Internet and the emergence of various online communication platforms, the expression and dissemination of individual opinions by netizens has become more convenient. Internet users constantly express their emotions and opinions on social networks, and the dissemination and interaction of related expression behaviors have generated a strong influence on online public opinion. This article analyzes the complex phenomena in the evolution of online public opinion based on online text data. Subsequently, modeling and simulation were conducted based on the continuous view dynamic BC model, and the shortcomings of the model were analyzed based on actual data. For the sudden change of individual opinions in the evolution of online public opinion, the individual opinion evolution data is indexed and fitted with sharp point mutation. Based on the mutation model, the elasticity index model is introduced to measure the likelihood of mutation in the evolution of online public opinion through the calculation of the elasticity index. Finally, the BC model was improved based on the elasticity index, and it was verified that the improved model is more in line with the evolution process of actual network public opinion, thus providing model reference for the study of actual network public opinion evolution.

articleTitle: Health State Estimation of Power Lithium-ion Batteries Based on Improved Sparrow Search Algorithm-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: As lithium-ion batteries undergo more charge and discharge cycles, their state of health (SOH) progressively deteriorates. To address this issue, a method is proposed for estimating the SOH lithium-ion batteries by optimizing a BP neural network with an improved sparrow search algorithm (ISSA). The introduction of the curve adaptive strategy and golden sine strategy into the standard sparrow search algorithm addresses the issue of local convergence in the middle and late iterations, thereby enhancing its global optimization ability. Consequently, this improved algorithm is employed to optimize the thresholds and weights of a BP neural network, leading to improved estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Lightweight Inception-V3 with Multi-scale Feature Fusion in Crop Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: This paper proposes a lightweight Inception V-3 network structure aimed at improving the efficiency and accuracy of plant disease recognition. By reducing the redundant parts of the Inception modules in the network structure, the model maintains its multi-scale feature extraction capability while reducing computational complexity and the number of parameters. Experiments are conducted on the publicly available PlantVillage, Baidu PaddlePaddle, and Northwest A&F University (NAFU). Compared with other classic network structures such as AlexNet, Mobilenet, Inception-v3, VGG16, and ResNet, the proposed model outperforms other models in terms of convergence rate, stability, accuracy, and loss. Furthermore, the training time of the model is greatly shortened after ablation and the AUC value is above 0.995. Experiments with several different data sets show better classification performance and generalization of the network. A lightweight, stable, high accuracy, and versatile network structure is obtained.

articleTitle: A Model Transfer Framework for PEMFC Water Fault Diagnosis Based on Hybrid Transfer Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is a “green” energy conversion device that is widely considered to be one of the best power sources for future electric vehicles and static energy systems. The task of fault diagnosis for PEMFC often faces the dilemma of data shortage, especially in terms of internal faults of the fuel cell. To solve these problems, We proposed a method for model transfer based on hybrid transfer learning to solve the problem of insufficient data sets in the target domain. The key point of this approach is to use the TrAdaBoost algorithm for transfer learning. In order to meet the algorithm’s requirements for initial diagnosis accuracy in practical applications, we combine a fine-tuning model transfer strategy with this algorithm. Compared with other methods, this method has significant improvement in water fault diagnosis accuracy.

articleTitle: Complex Spectrum Correlation Analysis Network based on Attention Convolution for SSVEP-BCI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Decoding algorithms play a crucial role in SSVEP-BCI systems, and certain conventional algorithms commonly used may exhibit notable declines in performance as the quantity of classification targets increases substantially. To address this limitation, we integrate the attention convolutional network with the TRCA principle to propose a novel convolutional neural network, Complex Spectrum Correlation Analysis Network based on Attention Convolution (CCA-AC). The model is evaluated using two datasets (1S window length) and compared against other models. Experimental results indicate that the proposed CCA-AC model achieves an accuracy of $94.49 \pm 4.11 \%$ for 12 classes of self-collected datasets and $92.79 \pm 4.10 \%$ for 40 classes of publicly available datasets, outperforming other deep learning models. The results manifest the effectiveness of CCA-AC in enhancing the performance and robustness of SSVEP-BCI systems. Further optimization of the model parameters is planned to improve its performance, and the correlation model holds promise for potential application to other EEG signals.

articleTitle: SAE-BiLSTM-Attention for PEMFC Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: To solve the challenge of fault diagnosis in proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFC), this paper proposes a fault diagnosis framework. It integrates sparse self-encoder (SAE) and Bi-directional long and short-term memory network (BiLSTM) with attention. The framework is designed to diagnose two primary types of faults: flooding and membrane dehydration in the PEMFC system. The 14-dimensional original features of the PEMFC test system are firstly downscaled using SAE to obtain a 7-dimensional feature representation; then the downscaled features are inputted into the BiLSTM-Attention fault diagnosis model for fault identification of the PEMFC. Experiments on the real test dataset show that the proposed SAE-BiLSTM-Attention model achieves an overall classification accuracy of 99.2%, which is better than that of the models using BiLSTM or BiLSTM-Attention, and verifies the effectiveness of the framework in PEMFC fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: PV Power Prediction Based on EMD-KPCA-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: To enhance the accuracy of PV (Photovoltaic) power prediction and the reliability of the power network, we presented a PV power prediction model based on EMDKPCA-BiLSTM. Firstly, the appropriate modal components are selected by Pearson coefficient criterion. Then, data preprocessing of raw PV signals is carried out by using EMD. Key components are extracted by KPCA and input dimensionality is reduced. Finally, the feature sequences are temporally modeled and power is predicted by BILSTM network. To validate the proposed PV power prediction model, we utilized actual data from a PV power plant in Shaanxi Province during January 2021. Experimental results indicate that our model outperforms the comparison model in terms of accuracy for predicting PV system output power.

articleTitle: Mixed Traffic Flow Simulation with a Dedicated Lane for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles: A Cell Transmission Model Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The development of Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) brings numerous potential benefits to the transportation system. However, during their widespread adoption, there will inevitably be a transitional phase where CAVs coexist with Human-driven Vehicles (HVs) for an extended period, presenting challenges to both traffic flow stability and the realization of CAV’s full advantages. Dedicated lanes can provide CAVs with exclusive road rights, thereby helping to restore traffic order. In light of this, this paper proposes an improved Cell Transmission Model (CTM) capable of effectively simulating the operational states of multi-lane mixed traffic flows. Through simulation experiments conducted in two different scenarios, this study not only verifies the accuracy and applicability of the model but also provides specific recommendations for the establishment of dedicated lanes.

articleTitle: Short-term Power Load Forecasting Based on WOA-VMD-Attention-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of short-term load forecasting accuracy of power system, a short-term load forecasting method based on the whale optimization algorithm optimized variational mode decomposition (VMD) and long short-term memory network with attention mechanism is proposed. Firstly, the whale optimization algorithm is utilized to optimize the key parameters of VMD, and VMD is used to decompose the original load sequence. Secondly, the Pearson correlation coefficients are employed to select the key influencing factors of load. The selected key factors and each modal component after VMD decomposition form a new data set, and the Attention-LSTM network is used to predict each modal component of VMD decomposition. Finally, the prediction results of each modal component are summed to obtain the final prediction result. Taking the actual load data of a city in Australian as an example, the accuracy and stability of the proposed method are verified by comparing with other models.

articleTitle: Energy Management of Community Integrated Energy Systems with Adaptive Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The energy market is transitioning to a more interactive competitive structure, highlighting the distributed nature of community integrated energy systems. However, the stochastic and uncertain characteristics of wind, solar, and natural gas sources present optimization challenges.The proposed adaptive dynamic programming (ADP)-based method effectively balances electrical and thermal loads by regulating multi-battery energy storage,thermal storagetanks, and interruptible loads (IL). This paper presents an energy management strategy for community integrated energy systems (CIES) using ADP. The effectiveness of this approach is demonstrated through a numerical example.

articleTitle: The System Dynamics Simulation-Based Analysis of Interlocking Directorate Network Evolution
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: New perspectives and ideas for a deeper understanding of how enterprises interact with each other via the inter-business social relations network have been provided by the study of the interlocking directorate network evolution with the help of System Dynamics(SD). This study, guided by the Organization Theory and Social Network Analysis, analyzes both the internal and external drivers that lead to the changes of the network and its functions by utilizing SD-supported simulation. And the result shows that higher marketization and more external shocks increase inter-business directorate linkages; risen directorate linkages and multi-dimensional proximity increase centrality; the longer information dissemination pathways and more external shocks increase the number of communities; and external shocks have a significant impact on the evolution of the interlocking directorate network.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Management Strategies for Fuel Cell Vehicles Based on Improved Rules
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In order to improve the energy economy and power system reliability of fuel cell hybrid electric vehicle (FCHEV), the conventional power following strategy was first improved and then a fuel cell operation control state machine was designed to reduce the lifetime degradation of the fuel cell by decreasing the number of fuel cell starts and stops and the output power fluctuation. To confirm the strategy’s efficacy, separate models for the overall vehicle energy management strategy and vehicle dynamics were established using Simulink and Cruise. These models were then jointly simulated under the CLTC-P driving scenarios. Compared to the traditional powerfollowing control strategy, the fuel cell’s equivalent hydrogen consumption had decreased by 8.38% and the number of startstop cycles has reduced by 50%. The proposed strategy improves the energy efficiency of the vehicle and also extends the fuel cell’s lifespan.

articleTitle: Load Forecasting Algorithm for Small Sample Datasets Based on Ensemble Learning and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the development of deep learning, the accuracy of load forecasting performs better and better on large sample datasets. However, there are areas in real life where there is only limited data, which is a challenge for accurate load forecasting. In this paper, we propose a novel load forecasting algorithm for small sample datasets based on ensemble learning and transfer learning. Firstly, we propose a parallel network forecasting model with CNN and Informer to enhance the deep mining of time series features, and multiple pre-trained models are obtained for load forecasting on multiple large sample datasets (source domains). Secondly, we design a voting regressor model in an ensemble learning manner. This model aggregates pre-trained model features from multiple source domain inputs to obtain the trained model. Then, the trained model was transfered learning and finetuned to the small sample target domain. Finally, the experimental results show that our method has a great improvement in load forecasting results for small sample datasets.

articleTitle: A Fast Outlier Image Detection Method Based on Thumbnails of Space borne SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Due to the SAR imaging mechanism and other factors such as satellite-ground abnormality, images generated from satellite data occasionally encounter quality problems, such as defocusing, ghosting, interference, and dark or light spots. If the outlier images caused by these qualityproblems are not detected and filtered in time, the subsequent processing may be ineffective, causing resource waste and decreasing the entire efficiency. The data amount of SAR image products is so huge that the computational burden is high. Detecting outlier images on the thumbnail scale will greatly lower the processing time and raise the comprehensive efficiency of the entire application chain. To detect outlier images, the deep-learning-based method is the optimal choice because of the self-learn and high-automation ability. Therefore, aiming to detect outlier images using thumbnails of space borne SAR images, this paper selects the Darknet model as the backbone and employs two architectures of different parameter scales, Darknet53 and Darknet19,to conduct the experiments. Experimental results validate the feasibility of outlier image detection only using thumbnails, and the detection accuracy basically meets the requirement when the efficiency is much higher than the current manual outlier image detection scheme.

articleTitle: Utilizing Natural Language Processing for Efficient Text Analysis in the Era of Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In this study, we explore the efficacy of various deep learning models, including TextCNN, Bi-GRU, and Attention-based LSTM, for short text classification tasks. We begin with data preprocessing and feature extraction techniques such as N -grams, information gain, and TF-IDF to prepare the datasets for analysis. The models are then trained and evaluated on both multi-category and four-category datasets. Our findings demonstrate that the LSTM model with an attention mechanism outperforms other models, achieving an accuracy of over $\mathbf{9 0 \%}$. We also provide a comprehensive performance evaluation using metrics like accuracy, precision, F1 score, confusion matrix, and ROC-AUC curve. The results suggest that integrating attention mechanisms significantly enhances the model’s ability to understand and classify short texts accurately.

articleTitle: Improving the Classification Performance of Miniature Asymmetric Visual Evoked Potentials through a Deep Learning Model with Dual Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In contrast to traditional visual stimulation, miniature asymmetric visual evoked potentials (aVEPs) offer the advantages of a smaller stimulus size and a decreased likelihood of inducing user fatigue, thereby enhancing their broad potential for application. Nevertheless, as the stimulus weakens, the issue of decoding accuracy remains to be studied. To address this challenge, we propose an efficient deep learning network called aVEPNet. The network incorporates a dual attention mechanism and an EEGNet module. The EEGNet temporal convolution layer’s capability to gather the spatial information of EEG signals is improved through the incorporation of a channel attention module. Additionally, a deep attention module is integrated between the temporal convolutional layers and the depthwise convolutional layers to facilitate the fusion of temporal and spatial domain features in EEG signals. This study employed an experimental paradigm consisting of eight characters and included the participation of eight individuals. By comparing the performance of the aVEPNet algorithm with that of the EEGNet algorithm using self-collected datasets, our results demonstrated an average accuracy increase of 8.22% across all eight participant datasets, with a maximum increase of 9.46 %} and a minimum increase of 5.46%. The ablation experiments further substantiated the indispensability of the two attention modules in aVEPNet.

articleTitle: Robust Tracking Group Consensus for Fractionalorder Multi-agent Systems with External Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: For fractional-order multi-agent systems with linear dynamic under external disturbances, we study its robust group tracking consistency problem under undirected fixed topology graphs in this paper. A control protocol capable of achieving robust group tracking consistency is proposed for double-integrator systems. Using the fractional-order Lyapunov method and the Mittag-Leffler stability theory, it is studied that the steady-state error of any two agents is limited to a small range defined by the boundary of external interference when there are external disturbances, and a sufficient condition to guarantee the robust group tracking consistency in the linear double-integrator dynamical systems is given. Finally, the proposed theory is verified using numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Safety Helmet Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: To solve the problems of missed detection, false detection, and low accuracy in complex environments when wearing helmets. This paper presents an enhanced YOLOv5 algorithm for detecting helmet-wearing. Initially, the article presents the incorporation of the Pyramid Squeeze Attention (PSA) mechanism during the feature extraction phase. This integration aims to gather spatial information across various scales and establish extensive dependencies to amalgamate more comprehensive feature details; then, Spatial and Channel reconstruction Convolution (ScConv) replaces the convolution in the C3 module, maintaining better model performance and optimizing the parameters of the model; finally, EIOU is employed instead of the CIOU loss function to expedite convergence speed. The experimental results indicate that the original algorithm achieves the mAP of 84% for hard hats, while the improved YOLOv5 algorithm for helmets attains the mAP of 91.6%, marking a 7.6% enhancement over the original algorithm. False detection and missed detections are reduced, and the effectiveness of the model is significantly improved in complex scenarios with dense targets and interfering objects. The enhanced model demonstrates evident practical utility.

articleTitle: Lightweight Tunnel Leakage Water Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv8n
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Tunnel leakage is one of the biggest hazards to shield tunnels, this paper proposes a lightweight tunnel water leakage target detection algorithm that improves YOLOv8n for the shortcomings of the existing tunnel water leakage target detection algorithms, such as poor precision and too many model parameters. To make feature fusion richer and reduce the model parameters, this paper proposes to use a bi-directional feature pyramid network on the head network. In addition, this paper uses multi-scale convolutional attention to adapt to the complex features of the leakage area in the tunnel. Finally, use the dilated reparam block to reduce the computational costs and expand the receptive field. The algorithm in this paper not only improves the detection accuracy compared to the original algorithm, but also significantly reduces the model parameters and computational costs. In addition, the superiority of this paper’s algorithm is verified through ablation experiments and comparisons with other mainstream target detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategy for Hybrid Vehicles Based on Hybrid Link Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Hybrid vehicles combine the advantages of conventional and pure electric vehicles, which can effectively alleviate the energy crisis and environmental pollution problems. Energy management strategies are the focus of research in the field of hybrid vehicles. Among them, the dynamic programming strategy can provide the global optimal solution, but it is difficult to realize the real-time application. The equivalent consumption minimization strategy (ECMS) can transform global optimization into instantaneous optimization. However, to determine the initial value of the equivalence factor, it also has defects. Therefore, this paper proposes a fuzzy optimization ECMS. multiple strategies comparison simulation results show that the strategies can follow the working conditions well. The fuel economy of various strategies is improved by 3.84%, 13.18% and 20.34% respectively compared to the previous strategy, which proves the effectiveness of the continuous optimization of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Modeling, Simulation, and Parameter Design of Actuation Mechanisms Based on New Magnetic Control Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of technology, the reliability and efficiency of power systems have become increasingly critical. In power systems, pole-mounted circuit breakers play a vital role. This paper presents a design scheme for an actuation mechanism of a pole-mounted circuit breaker based on new magnetic control materials. By analyzing the working principle of this actuation mechanism, a mathematical model was constructed, and a corresponding virtual prototype model was established using multi-body dynamics simulation software ADAMS and the dynamics mathematical model of this type of actuation mechanism. Key performance parameters of the circuit breaker were optimized using a quantum genetic algorithm. Simulation experiments verified that the proposed parameter settings achieved a closing time of 7.6 ms, demonstrating significant improvements in circuit breaker performance. The results of this study are of great importance for the optimization design and performance enhancement of circuit breakers in power systems.

articleTitle: Analytical Study of Liquid-Oxygen-Methane Rocket Engine Steady State Model Based on MATLAB/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In this paper, the liquid oxygen methane rocket engine is taken as the research object, and based on the idea of modular modeling, the engine simulation model is constructed by using the Simulink platform of MATLAB. First of all, mathematical models are established for each component of the rocket engine, and each module is connected with the working principle of the engine and the direction of the fluid flow to form a complete simulation model of the liquid-oxygen methane rocket engine. Then, the normal operating parameters of the engine simulation model are compared with the design values, and the typical engine faults are simulated and analyzed by the method of injecting fault factors. The results show that the maximum error of the normal operation parameters is $\mathbf{1. 0 5 \%}$, the model accuracy is high, and the changes of the fault data are in accordance with the fault mechanism. The simulation model can be used in the study of rocket engine failure.

articleTitle: The Magnetic Positioning System Based on Genetic Algorithm-optimized BP Natural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: This article details a magnetic positioning system using a genetic algorithm-optimized BPNN. The hardware includes a control module with an Arduino Mega 2560, a data collection module using Honeywell HMC5883L magnetometers for XYZ magnetic data, and a communication module integrating I2C via TCA9548A for sensor connections. The BPNN and genetic algorithm principles are combined in MATLAB to optimize weights and biases. Results show the system converges faster, predicts coordinates closer to actual values, and improves accuracy and robustness across environments, enhancing overall system performance and stability.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Portable Power Channel Detection Terminal
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The dispatching automation system is one of the main service objects of electric power communication, ensuring the safe and stable operation of the dispatching automation system is an important task of electric power communication, and also the key link to ensure the smooth production and operation of the electric power system. The current power communication system uses the serial port test software of a laptop computer to test the RS232 channel in daily operation and maintenance, which has low efficiency and inconvenient operation and only uses the DC voltage measurement file of a multimeter, which has low efficiency and high maintenance cost. Given the need for fault detection and the above problems, this portable detection terminal is designed by designing the peripheral circuit of a single-chip microcomputer to realize the identification of the signal transceiver terminal of industrial serial port, the detection of port voltage and the detection of loop transceiver channel of the dispatch system. The experimental results show that the terminal can effectively reduce the difficulty of detection, shorten the detection time, reduce the maintenance cost of the detection equipment, shorten the troubleshooting cycle, and ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: A High Accuracy Extraction Method of Point Cloud Vectors for Guiding Robotic Arm Movement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: A path planning method based on point cloud for robotic arm movement was proposed, which provides the 3D point and its vector direction for each moving position. First, an effective filtering algorithm is utilized to smooth the original point cloud. Then, the least squares method is employed to perform plane fitting on local regions of the filtered point cloud. Finally, the points with the corresponding normal vectors could be obtained for guiding the robotic arm movement. Experiments were designed to evaluate our method. Two filtering algorithms are carefully compared and chosen to simultaneously guarantee the accuracy of the gathered points and normal vectors, an evaluation metric is proposed. The point cloud of a standard sphere was acquired and fitted to calculate the sphere center. Each point and its normal vector determine one spatial line. The distance from the sphere center to each spatial line is defined as the quantitative indicator of the evaluation metric. Experimental results proved that the proposed method and evaluation metric are feasible and effective for precise motion control of robotic arms.

articleTitle: Reserve Cost Allocation Method Based on the Improved Shapley Value Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: By integrating a high proportion of renewable energy, the high uncertainty and limited accuracy of renewable energy output forecasts will increase additional reserve operation costs for the power system. Effectively measuring the reserve costs caused by each market member and fairly and reasonably allocating these costs are critical to promoting electricity market reform. This paper addresses uncertainties such as load and renewable energy by constructing a reserve demand model for the power system that considers the temporal fluctuation of renewable energy and load. This model obtains the reserve demand of the power system at a certain confidence level. Subsequently, a day-ahead energy-reserve joint market clearing model is constructed based on the nodal marginal price theory to derive the reserve costs. Finally, the Shapley value theory is used to quantify the marginal contribution of each responsible party to the reserve costs, and the reserve costs are proportionally allocated to the reserve responsible parties based on their contributions. The effectiveness of this method is verified using the improved IEEE 30-bus test system.

articleTitle: Lithium Battery Thermal Management System Based on Co-Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: New energy vehicles are a strategic choice for the transformation and high-quality development of China’s automobile industry. This article describes an innovative approach to optimizing the thermal management of lithium-ion batteries using COMSOL and Simulink. Experiments show that under the ambient temperature of 301 Kelvins and different discharge rates, the battery thermal management system can control the maximum temperature of the battery at 305 Kelvins, and the temperature control accuracy error is $2.6 \%$ of the battery temperature, which significantly reduces the risk of thermal runaway and ensures the safe operation of new energy vehicles.

articleTitle: UAV-YOLOv8n: An Improved YOLOv8 to Detect Small Target in UAV Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: UAV target detection is widely used in commercial, civil and military fields. However, UAV aerial images have few small target pixels and a large number of small targets, so there are omissions and false detections in target detection. Based on the above problems, an advanced YOLOv8n aerial photography detection algorithm is proposed. First, the RepNCSPELAN4 module is introduced, which has the functions of enhanced region representation and multi-scale fusion, which can effectively improve the correctness and robustness of the detection algorithm. Second, the SimAM (Simple Parameter-free Attention Module) attention mechanism is added after the backbone module and the RepNCSPELAN4 module to focus on the target region and refine the feature information. In addition, the convolution modules in the first and third layers of the backbone layer are replaced with dynamic convolution, which has higher parameter efficiency and feature expression ability, and can effectively improve the small target detection ability. Experiments show that the mAP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf> of the proposed model is improved by $1.8 \%$ on the VisDrone2021 public dataset, respectively, and there is also a significant improvement on the SeaDronesSee dataset.

articleTitle: Photoelectric Turret Control Method Based on Predictive Tracking and Sliding Mode Variable Structure Control with Extended State Observer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The friction torque and some other external disturbances existing in the servo system of the photoelectric turret will affect the control accuracy of the turret motion. At the same time, there is a delay problem in the off-target amount of information transmitted by the video tracker in the system, which will result in the tracking hysteresis of the system, thus significantly affecting the timeliness and accuracy of the control. To address the above two problems, in this paper, we propose a control strategy that combines a sliding mode variable structure control method based on an extended state observer with a novel tracking differentiator. The tracking differentiator compensates for the delayed information transmission, and the observer estimates the disturbance to compensate the system. Meanwhile, the observations are used to design the sliding mode control law, enabling the system to stabilize and converge quickly, suppressing the chattering phenomenon. Simulation results show that compared to traditional sliding mode control, this method reduces the maximum tracking error to 4% of the original one. Compared to predictive sliding mode control with an adaptive proportional coefficient, it reduces the maximum tracking error to 1/5 of the original one.

articleTitle: Thermal Control of Offshore Floating Photovoltaic Inverters Based on Single-Phase Immersion Cooling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Offshore floating photovoltaic (FPV) inverters face more severe heat accumulation and temperature rise problems due to the upgrade of protection level. Current research mainly focuses on the structural changes of the heat sinks, but this can exacerbate water accumulation and salt deposition, accelerating corrosion and limiting its heat dissipation performance. Therefore, this paper proposes a single-phase immersion cooling scheme. The proposed scheme involved the selection of three coolants: FC-40, Novec-7700, and PMX561, which are subjected to rigorous thermal simulation analyses under $35^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Compared with the original inverter model, the junction temperature of the IGBT module in the new models is reduced by $3.0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}, 3.1^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and $2.2^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, respectively. Meanwhile, the junction temperature of the bus capacitor is reduced by $15.5^{\circ} \mathrm{C}, 15.9^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and $12.0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, respectively. The temperature of the remaining components is also improved significantly. This result validates the effectiveness of the scheme proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Underactuated Ships Berthing Control Based on Sliding Mode Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In response to the challenges posed by shallow water effects, shore effects, environmental disturbances, as well as maneuvering constraints such as low speed and large drift angles, this paper conducts research on berthing problems of typical underactuated ships based on sliding mode variable structure control theory. Firstly, a three-degree-freedom maneuvering motion model of underactuated ships in harbors is established. Then, utilizing parameter identification methods, the first-order Nomoto model of the ship is obtained, upon which the sliding mode controller is designed. Considering the characteristics of model parameter uncertainty and enhanced wind disturbance at low speed within harbor, an improved extended state observer is designed to estimate internal and external disturbances, and compensation is performed during the controller design process. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that the berthing control algorithm for underactuated ships designed in this paper can achieve high-precision berthing trajectory tracking control, with strong robustness against external disturbances.

articleTitle: Lithium-Ion Battery State of Charge Estimation Based on a Second-order Central Difference Particle Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Estimating the state of charge (SOC) of battery is critical for safe and efficient battery use. However, the accuracy of the SOC estimation is reduced by the inherent noise of battery operation. A second-order central difference particle filtering method is proposed to improve the adaptability to noise and the accuracy of SOC estimation. The optimized particles are generated by the improved importance density function. To prove the feasibility of the algorithm, the new European driving cycle data at low temperature and room temperature are used for verification. The experimental findings show that the SCDPF algorithm has a high accuracy and the maximum error is lower than $1.26 \%$.

articleTitle: Optimization of Fuel Cell Hybrid System Configuration via Modified Multi-Objective Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to the capacity allocation problem in fuel cell hybrid vehicles. It introduces a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm nested Dynamic Programming (DP) strategy aimed at minimizing both manufacturing and operating costs. The outer loop employs a fast-converging Multi-Objective Particle Swarm Optimization (MOPSO) algorithm based on competitive mechanisms for parameter matching, while the inner loop employs DP for energy management. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated through simulation under specific operating conditions. Comparative analysis with traditional MOPSO demonstrates superior performance in terms of solution set diversity and convergence, affirming the efficacy of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Pose Estimation and Simulation of Non-Cooperative Spacecraft Based on Feature Points Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative framework for pose estimation based on feature points matching. First, a series of spatial points are selected as feature points on the shape of the spacecraft, and a descriptor is generated for each feature point. Then the projection point coordinates of the spatial point in the image are obtained according to different pose labels. In the offline training stage, the projection points and corresponding descriptors are used as labels of the input images for training the neural network. In the running stage, the convolutional neural network takes spacecraft image as input to obtain the descriptors and the position of keypoints in the image. Based on the descriptor, the matching relationship between the space points and the image feature points is established. Then the matching relationship is used to solve the spacecraft attitude using Random Sample Consensus (RANSAC) and Efficient Perspective-n-Point (EPnP). Extensive experiments have shown that this attitude estimation method is highly robust to image background noise.

articleTitle: Named Entity Recognition in Chinese Medical Texts Based on RoBERTa-WWM-IDCNN-CRF
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Electronic medical records and doctor-patient conversations contain a wealth of useful information, such as disease symptoms, drug names, and cure cycles. Traditional deep learning approaches utilize bidirectional recurrent neural networks to encode text, which cannot effectively capture long-distance dependencies in text. In order to identify medical entity types in various texts more accurately, a named entity recognition approach based on RoBERTa-WWM-IDCNN-CRF is proposed. This approach introduces the RoBERTa-WWM pre-trained model, in order to improve the overall understanding of long Chinese texts for the first time. The model generates semantic representations containing prior knowledge. Then, the generated semantic representations are feed to the IDCNN to extract sentence level characteristics. Finally, the global optimal solution is obtained and the results of the named entity are produced through the CRF. The experiment indicates that the improvement of $F_{1}$ score, accuracy, and recall of RoBERTa-WWM-IDCNN-CRF model are 7.94%, 4.52% and 10.02% comparing with the classical BiLSTM-CRF model.

articleTitle: The Research Focuses on the Detection Method of Armored Vehicles in Fog.
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Foggy weather is often encountered on the battlefield, and environmental visibility will be reduced when conducting operations on foggy days, which often affects UAV reconnaissance of armored vehicles on the ground. To improve the detection accuracy of armored vehicles on foggy days, this paper first applies the AOD-Net network to defog the foggy images, then improves the YOLOv5 network model by replacing the original head structure with the DynamicHead structure and uses the RepGFPN pyramid network in the network to detect the target in the defogged images. The experimental results show that the accuracy and recall of the improved network model are increased by 1% and 3% respectively, and the mAP is increased by 2.7%, which effectively improves the accuracy of recognizing armored vehicles in foggy images. By the comparisons between the original images and the defogged ones by the improved model, the experimental results show that there are a significant increases in the detection accuracy of the tank targets after the images are defogged.

articleTitle: Operational Fault Diagnosis and Mixed Reality Inspection for Building Fire Protection Facilities
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the emergence of high-rise/super high-rise buildings, fire safety hazards have become more complex and diverse, and the problems of low integrity and poor reliability of fire facilities have become increasingly prominent. To improve the inspection management level of fire facilities and fire prevention capabilities, this paper carries out research on the operational fault diagnosis of building fire facilities and mixed reality inspection technology. Firstly, a set of technical frameworks for fault diagnosis and mixed reality inspection of building fire facilities was constructed. Taking the firefighting facilities experimental platform of the Tianjin Fire Research Institute as the research object, a time-series condition monitoring system was developed to collect real-time data of key components. Then, a knowledge graph of the compressed air foam system was established, and fault relationship paths were analyzed through graph traversal algorithms and fault criteria. Based on grey correlation analysis, the correlation between the monitoring data of fault point and system output was calculated to complete fault location and diagnosis. Finally, real-scene recognition and mixed reality development of fire facilities were carried out, and three sets of facility operation tests were conducted. HoloLens 2 device was used to view the normal operation and fault diagnosis data of fire facilities, verifying the effectiveness of the proposed fault diagnosis and mixed reality inspection methods for fire facilities.

articleTitle: A Enhanced Feature Extraction for 3D Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: 3D object detection is crucial for autopilot and augmented reality applications. However, accurate feature extraction is the key to achieve high-precision detection, but traditional methods face the challenges of information loss and computational inefficiency. To address this, we propose an enhanced feature extraction method. We first divide the 3D space into voxel grids of varying scales. Then, using 3D sparse convolution, we extract features which are compressed along the Z axis to form BEV (Bird’s Eye View) feature images. An efficient multi-scale attention mechanism is then employed to enhance these BEV features. The refined feature map is subsequently located and classified through a CT-stacking module and RPN (Region Proposal Network). Voxel features from the proposal and 3D backbone are passed through a voxel RoI pool to directly extract RoI features from the 3D features for further refinement. Finally, a cascaded attention network refines the proposal and strengthens confidence prediction. Experiments on test set validate our method effectiveness, showing improved accuracy over traditional voxel methods. Overall, this enhanced feature extraction technique offers a promising solution for 3D target detection, particularly in scenarios demanding high real-time performance and precision.

articleTitle: Adaptive Regression Approach of Equivalent Factor for Equivalent Consumption Minimization Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: An equivalent factor (EF) adaptive regression equivalent consumption minimization strategy (EAR-ECMS) is introduced to enhance the fuel economy of a hybrid powertrain in this brief. Firstly, an ECMS control framework is established, grounded in the modeling of power plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs). Secondly, leveraging the traffic information system, the reference trajectory of state of charge (SOC) is determined in real-time by using a Markov-chain predictor. Subsequently, an EAR-ECMS is formulated by integrating the bisection method and polynomial penalty subfunction, following an analysis of the relationship between the value of the penalty function, the oscillation amplitude of the EF, and the fuel economy of the vehicle. Finally, simulation results are executed to verify that EAR-ECMS can effectively enhance the robustness of battery $S O C$ and the overall vehicle’s fuel economy, compared with the thermostat control strategy (TCS) and A-ECMS.

articleTitle: Optimized Complex Convolutional Neural Network for Steady-State Visual Evoked Potentials Signal classification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) is one of the most commonly used paradigms in the BCI system, which produces a significant response to visual stimuli of a specific frequency. How to better improve the classification performance of SSVEP signals is currently the main task. In this paper, a modified C-CNN-SVM model of EEG signal is proposed, aiming to enhance the precision of SSVEP signal classification. Firstly, spectral features are obtained from the SSVEP signal using fast fourier transform (FFT) as input to the model. FFT obtains 128 data lengths of the SSVEP signal, including 64 real part data and 64 complex part data. Then, CNN is used to further extract features, and finally, support vector machine (SVM) is used for classification. The experimental results show that the modified C-CNN-SVM model achieves an average accuracy of 93.86%, which is better than the traditional CCA, FBCCA and TRCA algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Hierarchical Beehive-Shaped Distribution Grid Scheduling Based on Cloud-Edge Coordination
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the development of smart and digital grids, the issue of privacy protection for grid data has gradually received attention. This paper proposes a study on coordinated dispatch of honeycomb-shaped distribution grids based on cloud-edge collaboration. First, a topology structure of distribution grids composed of multiple microgrids is established, and an electric energy exchange mechanism is established between microgrids. second, based on the cloud-edge computing framework, active distribution grid dispatch models are established for the cloud layer and dispatch models for edge microgrids are established. Finally, simulation results prove that the effectiveness of the beehive-shaped distribution grid scheduling stratagy.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization Decision for Business Allocation on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The increasing adoption of blockchain technology in supply chain management has sparked widespread interest. However, collaborative order allocation led by enterprises in the chain still faces challenges, including efficiency, traceability and trust issues. In this paper, based on a multi-objective genetic algorithm, an order allocation model is proposed with the objective function of maximizing the interests of the chain owner enterprise (minimizing cost, maximizing efficiency, and maximizing service quality), maximizing the number of enterprises participating in the chain, and optimizing the stability of the blockchain. The optimal solution is determined by employing the TOPSIS decision-making method. Finally, simulation experiments are used to demonstrate the stability and validity of the model.

articleTitle: ArUco Code-Based Calibration Method for LiDAR and Camera Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In recent years, the seamless integration of LiDAR and camera systems has become paramount, particularly within the dynamic landscape of autonomous driving applications. To enhance the robustness of traditional LiDAR-camera joint calibration methods, this paper proposes a LiDAR-camera joint calibration method based on an ArUco marker board. The system utilizes a Senyun camera and a Suteng 64-line LiDAR as sensors. The LiDAR-camera joint calibration method based on the ArUco marker board was implemented through ArUco marker recognition and pose detection. The experimental results show that employing ArUco markers for joint calibration not only enhances robustness but also improves vehicle pose estimation accuracy and calibration efficiency.

articleTitle: Recovery Strategy of Distribution Network Power Restoration Considering Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Focused on the problem of fault recovery in non-fault power loss areas of distribution networks with electric vehicle charging stations, reasonable scheduling of electric vehicle charging stations is carried out, and a centralized power supply fault recovery method is proposed. Firstly, a typical load fluctuation model and an electric vehicle charging station model were established; Transform the distribution network fault recovery problem into a multi-objective optimization problem, a centralized power supply fault recovery model is established, constraints on electric vehicle charging stations and incentive mechanisms for setting minimum power scheduling values are added; Furthermore, provide a multi period distribution network fault recovery process that takes into account the load of electric vehicle charging stations. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method was verified through numerical examples. When the electric vehicle charging station participates in the recovery of distribution network faults, the total number of switch action changes is 2, which is less than 5 times excluding electric vehicles. The minimum voltage value is between 0.9517 and 0.9584, which meets the power supply voltage standard GB/T 12325-2008. The system network loss meets the requirements for normal operation.

articleTitle: Image Monitoring Technology for Industrial Emissions Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In industrial emissions monitoring, the complexity of environmental conditions and the close association between emissions characteristics and environmental factors make the extraction of key emissions features a prominent challenge. To address this challenge, this study introduces the BiFormer attention mechanism into the backbone network of the YOLOv8 model, significantly enhancing the model’s ability to extract various industrial emissions features, such as gases and smoke, and improving the model’s adaptability and robustness in complex industrial environments. Considering the requirements for real-time monitoring of industrial emissions and the limitations of device resources, this paper integrates partial convolutional modules (PConv) to replace the conventional 3x3 convolutional modules in the bottleneck of the feature extraction network, reducing memory access frequency and computational redundancy, and further optimizing the model’s operational speed. Experimental outcomes indicate that the enhanced YOLOv8 model boosted the mean average precision by 3.2 percentage points on the publicly available smoke dataset and decreased computational load by 15%, thereby supporting efficient operation on resource-limited devices and fulfilling the requirements of practical industrial applications.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Theory Based Control Allocation Strategy of Composite Control Missile
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Direct force has the advantages of fast response speed, large thrust force and free from the influence of missile flying height and speed. Composite control can not only make use of the advantages of direct force but also give full play to the stabilizing role of pneumatic rudder, to achieve accurate hit on high-speed maneuvering targets. It is a key problem to allocate control commands to anti-thrust engines and pneumatic rudders. In this paper, fuzzy control theory based control allocation strategy of composite control missile is studied. Considering overload tracking deviation and remaining flight time as input variables, control coefficients of engines and pneumatic rudders as output, a fuzzy divider is designed. When overload tracking deviation is constant, changing according to sine law and changing according to square wave law respectively, control command variation laws of engines and pneumatic rudders are studied. The research results show that the designed fuzzy allocator can realize reasonable allocation of control commands, and a large number of simulation results verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Simulation of Water Transport in Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell Using a One-dimension Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell (PEMFC) vehicles have been widely studied. However, PEMFCs are constrained to large-scale commercialization for safety and durability. Under real working conditions, the humidity of the PEMFC changes with drastically fluctuated load current, which seriously affects the electrochemical reaction, and may even causes serious faults-membrane drying or flooding. Therefore, it is necessary to develop accurate model on crucial internal states and simulate the dynamic characteristics of PEMFC, so that accurate estimation of the internal state can be the vital foundation for feedback control, ultimately to optimize the performance of PEMFC. In this paper, a one-dimension model of water transport across the Nafion® membrane for observer is presented. The analytical model is proposed with two main water transport mechanisms: back diffusion and electro-osmotic drag. The relationship between membrane water content and the easily measurable variables is foundation of observer subsequently. The simulated results show that the MAPE of stack voltage is 8%, which is precise enough to apply convergence algorithm.

articleTitle: An Assessment Method of Potential of Demand Response Resource Characteristic Atlas Considering Regional Feature Mapping
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Demand response is a crucial technical approach in power systems, and leveraging demand response resources can significantly enhance the economic and environmental benefits of the power system. This paper first analyzes the demand response characteristics of aggregated resources across multiple temporal and spatial scales based on regional characteristics and market operation mechanisms. Then, a Distributed Scalable Adaptive Network (DSAN) based on feature similarity is proposed to evaluate the user demand response potential. Through parameter feature alignment analysis using local maximum mean discrepancy, aggregators’ response potential distribution characteristics across multiple temporal and spatial scales are investigated. Finally, the response capacity of load aggregators across multiple temporal scales is obtained by utilizing data from users who have participated in demand response programs. Case studies demonstrate that the proposed method effectively reduces the upfront workload and costs for load aggregators while improving the accuracy of demand response potential assessments.

articleTitle: Classifying the Presence of Aircraft Images in RSVP Tasks Using EEG: A Deep Learning Approach for Addressing Class Imbalance in RSVP Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) tasks, the imbalance in sample numbers can severely limit the classification performance of RSVP electroencephalography (EEG). Existing solutions typically employ rebalancing strategies (such as reweighting and resampling) to reduce the effects of class imbalance. While these strategies enhance the classifier’s learning capability (by altering the distribution of training data to focus more on samples from minority classes) and reduce the model’s bias towards majority classes, they inadvertently harm the representational power of learned deep features. To confront this challenge, this study suggests an approach that separates the feature extraction and classification processes of the model during training. This approach aims to better capture features from imbalanced EEG data while accurately classifying them. In this method, the feature extraction process is responsible for learning features from all specimens, whilst the categorizer establishes better boundaries between target and non-target classes. To assess the categorization efficacy of the proposed model in this study, experiments were conducted by comparing it with the Hierarchical Discriminant Component Analysis (HDCA) and EEGNet models on self-collected datasets. The experimental results indicate that the model demonstrates certain advantages in EEG classification for RSVP tasks. A general solution is provided to address the issue of sample imbalance.

articleTitle: Point Set Registration Based on Adaptive Maximum Correntropy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the iterative closest point algorithm has a lot of noise in data and poor robustness to outliers, this paper proposes a point set registration algorithm based on the adaptive maximum correntropy criterion. The aim is to enhance the robustness of traditional registration methods, improve registration accuracy, and reduce registration time. Firstly, the maximum correntropy criterion is introduced to effectively identify and eliminate noise and outliers in the data. Secondly, a parameter-adaptive iterative approach is proposed to iteratively remove noise and outliers in the data, thus improving the accuracy and robustness of point set registration. Experimental results on datasets containing a large amount of noise and outliers demonstrate that the proposed algorithm effectively enhances the accuracy and robustness of point set registration.

articleTitle: Liquid Oxygen/Liquid Methane Rocket Engine Measurement Point Selection Method Based on Fault Detection Capability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In order to improve the effectiveness of liquid oxygen/liquid methane rocket engine fault detection, the paper aims to find the most suitable measurement point parameters to characterize the current fault. Firstly, a nonlinear simulation model of the engine system is established to simulate methane pump fault, oxygen pump fault, methane turbine efficiency loss and oxygen turbine efficiency loss. Secondly, the sensitivity, correlation and stability of the parameters of the measurement point to the fault are selected as evaluation indicators, and the fuzzy hierarchical analysis method is used to determine the weights of the indicator dimensions, so as to improve the scientificity of the selection of the measurement points. Finally, the methane pump outlet pressure, oxygen pump outlet pressure, methane turbine rotational speed and oxygen turbine rotational speed are selected as the optimal measurement points for four kinds of fault detection using the above method. The research work carried out in this paper has certain reference value for the selection of measurement points for rocket engine fault detection.

Author Keywords: liquid oxygen/ liquid methane rocket engine

articleTitle: Lines Design of Underwater Vehicle Using Analytic Hierarchy Process and Approximation Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In this paper, the lines design of an underwater vehicle is investigated. Optimization design is used to obtain the optimal lines.
