The underwater vehicle’s hydrodynamic performances and energy consumption are involved in the framework of optimization. Specifically, the resistance and maneuverability of an underwater vehicle are concerned in the hydrodynamic performances. The energy consumption of the underwater vehicle concerns the efficient power. To weight the disciplines in the overall optimization objective, analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is used. To replace the numerical simulation model in discipline analysis, an approximate model is established. SUBOFF model is optimized by using the proposed method. Optimization results reveal the effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Fuel Cell Air Supply System in Variable Altitude Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The efficiency of the fuel cell and dynamics of the air supply system are significantly affected by altitude changes. To comprehensively investigate the influences of oxygen excess ratio (OER) and inlet pressure on output performance at different altitude, a variable altitude model that includes air compressor mechanism modeling is proposed. Experimental verification shows that the error of the compressor model within 5% at different altitude, the error of the voltage of the variable altitude model within 1.5% and the error of the air supply pressure within 1% in different altitude environments. The analysis of the impact of altitude and air supply parameters indicates that the optimal oxygen excess ratio tends to decrease with increasing altitude due to the saturation effect of the flow rate on performance enhancement, while the optimal air pressure needs to consider the balance between stack and auxiliary system.

articleTitle: Research on Sliding Mode MPPT and Adaptive Backstepping Control for Isolated Island Photovoltaic Microgrid System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The paper primarily investigates the output power of DC photovoltaic cells and the control of active power in an isolated island photovoltaic microgrid system with energy storage. A controller for the photovoltaic microgrid is designed to handle both DC and AC. Firstly, a mathematical model of the photovoltaic microgrid is established, and the basic framework of the system is constructed. Secondly, a controller based on non-singular terminal sliding mode maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control strategy is designed to ensure stable power output from the photovoltaic cells. An energy storage system is employed in the DC part to mitigate fluctuations in grid active power caused by changes in light radiation and temperature. The entire system adopts constant voltage and constant frequency (V/F) control strategy to account for non-deterministic influences on model parameters. Additionally, an adaptive backstepping virtual controller is designed, followed by construction of a final controller. The stability and convergence properties are proven using Lyapunov stability theory, while MATLAB/Simulink software verifies that this design effectively controls output power and active power.

articleTitle: Switching Active Disturbance Rejection Tracking Control of Hypersonic Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In order to solve the uncertainty problem caused by parameter variations and external disturbances, a linear/nonlinear switching active disturbance rejection control method based on adaptive synchronous switching is proposed for hypersonic vehicles. Firstly, the hypersonic vehicle model is decomposed into velocity subsystem and altitude subsystem for designing the controller. Secondly, the bas function is used instead of fal function to improve the control performance of nonlinear active disturbance rejection control. Then, the neural network is used to realize the adaptability of the switching conditions. Finally, the real-time control coefficient and soft switching mode are applied to the design of linear/nonlinear switching state error feedback laws, so as to improve the control accuracy of the system and prevent the jitter problem caused by direct switching of the controllers. The simulation results show that the designed linear/nonlinear switching active disturbance rejection control has better stability and stronger anti-disturbance ability than the linear or nonlinear active disturbance rejection control.

Author Keywords: linear/nonlinear switching active disturbance rejection control

articleTitle: Water Fault Diagnosis for PEMFC based on an Improved Equivalent Circuit Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The water faults significantly impact the durability and performance of the proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC). As a non-invasive detection method, the equivalent circuit model (ECM) based water fault diagnostic method offers great interpretability for internal states of the PEMFC. However, the conventional ECM of the PEMFC has poor fitting accuracy in the high-frequency region. To address this, an improved ECM is proposed by introducing constant phase element (CPE) and short Warburg impedance elements, which can reflect the effects of plate unevenness and dielectric heterogeneity. Compared to the second-order RC and R(RC)(RC) models, the proposed ECM increases the fitting accuracy by 96.5% and 97.9%, respectively. The features derived from the ECM are used to develop the water fault classification model based on the particle swarm optimization clustering. To validate the proposed method, a PEMFC water fault dataset are generated from experiments, and all 35 sets of data are accurately classified. Compared to the K-means clustering, the classification precision of the proposed method analysis increased by 23.86%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Carbon Emission Flow of Power System Considering Network Loss and Renewable Energy Output
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: This paper proposes a carbon emission flow calculation method for the power system considering the network loss and the carbon reduction contribution of renewable energy. Aiming at overcoming the limitations of existing calculation methods that don’t include the network loss and don’t quantify the contribution of renewable energy emission reduction. Node loss is introduced into each node based on the real lossy network. The “node loss” consists of the network loss shared by each load node and the additional loss shared by each contact branch. In addition, the power flow distribution of the system is calculated based on it, which converts the actual power grid into an ideal lossless network. Based on the carbon emission flow in the lossless network, the carbon reduction contribution of the renewable energy units is investigated from the perspective of load. Finally, the rationality and accuracy of this method are verified by a 30-node system.

articleTitle: Methodology for Regional Carbon Emission Projections and Scenario Analysis Based on the STIRPAT Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Analyzing the factors that influence carbon emission reduction and predicting the peak year of carbon emissions will help the region clarify the direction of emission reduction efforts and take the lead in achieving carbon peak and carbon neutrality. This paper proposes a regional dual-carbon target and path planning method. Firstly, an indicator system is established to explore the relationship between regional carbon emissions and factors such as the economy, population, and energy efficiency consumption. Indicators with higher correlation are selected through gray correlation analysis. Then, the Stochastic Impacts by Regression on Population, Affluence, and Technology (STIRPAT) model is constructed to predict carbon emissions in the region. Lastly, a scenario design is conducted for the dual-carbon target, predicting carbon emissions under different scenarios while considering carbon sinks. The results are analyzed to finalize the regional dual-carbon target and path.

articleTitle: Laser Echo Modeling and Testing Verification in Atmospheric Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Laser ranging device is one of the indispensable means for weapon systems to acquire target distance, and the laser detection distance model is established in the atmospheric environment to provide a necessary technical proposal for the demonstration and verification of laser ranging device. Firstly, the target echo energy and target distance model are established, the corresponding echo energy is calculated at three distance segments, and according to the given echo energy threshold, it is judged whether there is an echo or not. Then the correspondence between the aerial target distance and the echo is obtained through the tests. By comparing the testing statistics data of the actual system with the theoretical calculation data, they are a good conformity, which verifies the correctness and accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: High Precision State of Health Estimation of Lithium-ion Batteries Based on PSO-LSSVM AdaBoost Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The accurate estimation of the state of health (SOH) of lithium-ion batteries is paramount for the maintenance and longevity of battery management systems (BMS). To enhance the precision and robustness of SOH prediction models for lithium-ion batteries, this article introduces a novel approach that utilizes a particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm to optimize the least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) model for battery SOH estimation. The study focuses on three individual batteries from the NASA battery dataset as the primary research subjects. The PSO algorithm is then employed to optimize the regularization parameters and kernel parameters of the LSSVM, ensuring that the model is tailored to the specific characteristics of the battery data. Furthermore, the AdaBoost algorithm is integrated into the framework to train the PSO-optimized LSSVM, aiming to further boost the model’s predictive capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed model, indicating its potential for accurate SOH estimation in lithium-ion batteries.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging/Discharging Control Method based on Deep Reinforcement Learning for Photovoltaic Energy Storage Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the implementation of Internet of Things technology and the proliferation of electric vehicles (EVs), real-time control of EV charging/discharging is one of the keys to ensuring the safe, stable and efficient operation of smart grids. Nevertheless, existing EV charging/discharging control methods fail to comprehensively consider photovoltaic power generation, dynamic energy price, and the randomness and uncertainty of EV loads. This article proposes an EV charging/discharging control method for photovoltaic storage stations based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL). Considering the EV charging demand, photovoltaic energy output, and time-of-use electricity price, under the conditions of meeting the EV charging demand and photovoltaic energy utilization efficiency, the Markov decision process (MDP) of EV charging/discharging control based on DRL is established with the goal of minimizing user charging costs and enhancing user satisfaction. Considering the continuity of EV charging/ discharging action, an improved deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithm is applied for the above scenario. Finally, simulation results are conducted on the proposed method, and comparable with disordered EV charging. The results verify that the recommend approach and model can significantly absorb photovoltaic energy and enhance user satisfaction while saving user costs by $2 7. 9 4 \%$.

articleTitle: Simulation of Control of Cleaning Vehicle Robot Arm for Large Photovoltaic Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation has experienced rapid development in recent years, but its cleanliness still faces high costs. This article conducts simulation analysis on the mechanical arm control of photovoltaic automatic cleaning vehicles, introduces the basic principle of the mechanical arm of photovoltaic cleaning vehicles, constructs a mathematical model of the mechanical arm, and conducts simulation analysis. Based on the mathematical model presented in this article, the motion control of the robotic arm can be achieved, providing support for the automatic cleaning of large photovoltaic power plants.

articleTitle: CFD Simulation of Flight Vehicle Optical Dome and Flow Field Based on Solid-Fluid Coupling Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: At high velocity flight, the infrared imaging system encounters significant aero-optical disturbances due to the uneven gas flow around the aircraft’s forward section and the elevated temperatures of the optical dome. In the simulation study of aero-optical effects, hydrodynamic calculations of the gas flow field and optical dome are required. This paper examines the utilization of the solid-fluid coupling approach in simulating aero-optical phenomena from the perspective of fluid dynamics computations. This paper undertakes the geometric modelling of the airflow environment and optical dome of a blunt-nose front-window flight vehicle. Utilizing ICEM, the mesh generation for both the gaseous flow domain and the solid optical dome is executed. Subsequently, Fluent software facilitates the performance of hydrodynamic simulations, concurrently extracting vital parameters from both the flow field and the optical dome. The method in this paper can be used in the calculation and analysis of aero-optical effects of high-speed flight vehicles.

articleTitle: Structural Optimization of a Magnetically Operated Actuator Mechanism for 10kV Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: As the demand for reliable power supply in power systems grows, ensuring the performance of circuit breaker operating mechanisms is crucial. This performance is pivotal to the stability of the power grid, the speed of fault recovery, and the equipment’s lifespan. In this paper, we introduce a structural optimization plan for a new magnetic control operating mechanism designed for 10kV circuit breakers. Employing three-dimensional and mathematical modeling, complemented by finite element analysis with Maxwell software, we delved into an in-depth study of the mechanism’s structure, performance, and materials. We further conducted a parametric design and comparative analysis of key components. The simulation results, which exclude the spring load, demonstrate that the optimized circuit breaker can achieve a closing velocity of 3.07 m/s, an electromagnetic force peaking at 2.7 kN, and a closure time minimized to 8.5 ms. These enhancements notably improve the mechanism’s closing efficiency. Consequently, our research introduces a novel perspective to the field of reliability studies for magnetic control operating mechanisms.

articleTitle: Electroencephalogram Channel Selection Method for Lower Limb Motor Imagery Based on ReliefF-Spearman
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Research on lower limb motor imagery using electroencephalography (EEG) signals has significant applications in lower limb rehabilitation and neural repair. However, practical applications often face challenges due to the inconvenience of using numerous EEG channels. Efficient EEG channel selection methods are therefore crucial. This paper introduces a novel algorithm based on ReliefF-Spearman for EEG signal classification in lower limb motor imagery. The algorithm selects EEG channels by considering individual differences and band signal characteristics, integrating ReliefF’s weighting concept with Spearman’s correlation principle. Results demonstrate that it reduces the required number of channels significantly compared to traditional algorithms based on ReliefF while maintaining classification accuracy. Furthermore, the channel selection outcomes are independent of user experience. Spatial distribution analysis shows that selected channels align with established neurophysiological motor imagery locations, validating the approach’s scientific reliability. This algorithm provides new insights into EEG channel selection for motor imagery research.

articleTitle: High-Precision Temperature Control Design and On-Orbit Verification of Star Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Star sensor is a crucial device for spacecraft attitude determination, and its thermal stability directly influences the precision of star sensor measurements. In this study, with the constraint of limited thermal control resources, a comprehensive thermal design task analysis was conducted considering various aspects such as the star sensor body, operational orbit, spacecraft attitude, sensor positioning, and installation boundaries. This analysis was tailored to meet the high-precision temperature control requirements $\left(20 \pm 1^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$ of a high-resolution remote sensing satellite. A novel star sensor thermal control design and analysis methodology, based on transient duty cycle single-stage temperature control, was proposed. The efficacy of this thermal design was subsequently validated through simulation analyses and on-orbit verification. The results indicated that the on-orbit temperature of the star sensor was consistently stable, with fluctuations not exceeding $0.2^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, thus satisfying the $\pm 1^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ requirement. This confirmed the rationality and correctness of the thermal design analysis approach. This research offers a valuable reference for the thermal control design of equipment operating within sunsynchronous orbits, particularly those with limited thermal control resources and stringent high-precision temperature control demands. ()

articleTitle: Detection Method for Loose Strand Defects in Transmission Line Based on ORB_RANSAC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Conductors is the main component of overhead transmission line, and their defects affect the stable operation of the power system. A detection method for loose strand defects in transmission line based on ORB_RANSAC is proposed. Firstly, The ORB algorithm is employed for feature point extraction and perform matching, and the matching points are roughly removed using the Hamming distance threshold method. Then, based on the RANSAC algorithm, the mismatched points in the feature points are calculated to further remove the pairs of mismatched points. Finally, algorithm comparison experiments are conducted based on the on-site running images of the wire. The experimental results show that the average matching accuracy of the ORB_RANSAC algorithm reaches 90.02%, which is 11.58% and 8.78% higher than that of the ORB algorithm and SIFT algorithm, respectively, meeting the accuracy requirements for wire defect detection.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Demand Response Potential Assessment and Adjustable Load Optimization Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the gradual advancement of electricity marketization, demand response (DR) plays a critical role in the new power system, and it is necessary to quickly and accurately identify the high potential DR resources on the user side. Aiming at the problem of the cumbersome DR potential calculation process and the power consumption characteristics of different industries, this paper proposes a data-driven DR potential assessment and adjustable load optimization scheduling method. A set of potential multi-dimensional evaluation comprehensive indicators is established by analyzing user load characteristics and combining seasonal weather conditions and holidays. The technique for order preference by similarity to an ideal solution (TOPSIS) algorithm analyzes the comprehensive index of users’ DR potential, accurately identifies high-potential users, and forms an adjustable load optimization scheduling strategy based on peak load ratio and DR potential value. Finally, an adjustable resource analysis is carried out with a typical user as an example, which verifies the effectiveness of this method and can provide effective support for demand-side management.

articleTitle: Path Planning Using Improved Hybrid A* Algorithm for Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The Hybrid A* algorithm is suitable for Ackermann-type mobile robots with nonholonomic constraints. However, in practical path planning, such issues as long search times, inefficient search efficiency, and excessive planning path changes causing unstable robot motion still exist. To improve the effectiveness of path planning, this paper optimizes the Hybrid A* algorithm by using variable search step size and designing a path evaluation function during node expansion. Path planning experiments are conducted based on simulation and physical experimental platforms. The results show that the improved algorithm reduces the search nodes and planning time, effectively enhancing the algorithm’s search performance and efficiency. In addition, it avoids pose errors caused by reverse driving, ensuring the priority and smoothness of forward driving, and achieves efficient and stable path planning for Ackermann-type mobile robots.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Lithium-ion Battery using Dragonfly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Parameter identification is the basis for state estimation, energy equalization, and charging optimization in the battery management system. In this paper, the parameter identification scheme using Dragonfly Algorithm (DA) is developed for lithium-ion batteries. The system model is discretised for constructing the voltage error evaluation function according to the first-order RC model. The DA is used for model parameter identification. The estimation effects of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Ant Lion Optimizer (ALO) are compared. The experimental results show that the proposed DA parameter identification algorithm has higher estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Prescribed Performance Attitude Control for Hypersonic Flight Vehicle based on Predetermined-Time Extended State Observer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In this paper, in order to solve the problems of high nonlinearity, strong coupling and external interference in hypersonic flight vehicle (HFV) control, an active disturbance rejection controller based on predetermined-time extended state observer (PTESO) and prescribed performance control (PPC) is proposed to realize the tracking of attitude angle. We design three independent controllers for the three channels of HFV to control the three variables: pitch angle, roll angle, and yaw angle, which reduces the coupling problem between channels and improves the control effect. PPC converges the dynamic performance and steady state performance of the system within the specified range. PTESO improves the accuracy of the observer. Based on the results of simulation can draw the following conclusion: compared with LESO, this method can rapidly converge the tracking error and has better tracking effect on the attitude angle setting value.

articleTitle: Simulation of Triboelectric Nanogenerator Output Characteristics of Different Resistance Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the increasing demand for green energy, triboelectric nanogenerators (TENG) have the potential to harvest energy from the environment in a small size range to power microelectronic devices. Still, its performance is affected by impedance matching problems. In this study, the effect of impedance matching on the performance of the TENG was investigated. The generator output power is simulated by Simulink software, and the theoretical usability of TENG was demonstrated by driving the load. Firstly, a mathematical model of the TENG was developed to consider its operating principle, and the transferred charge and voltage-current output under different impedance conditions were simulated. Then, the effect of impedance matching on the output of the TENG on its generator was analyzed by adjusting the impedance of the TENG with the external circuit. The results show that by adjusting the impedance value, the generator can be made to work in a more efficient operating region, which helps to promote the development of TENG technology.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method for the Swing of a Quadrotor Flight Suspension System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The aim of this study is to explore optimization control methods for suspension systems during the flight of quadcopters. The traditional control method of suspension system has some problems such as oscillation and instability, so an optimization scheme based on Gaussian pseudo-general algorithm is proposed in this paper. Through numerical simulation and actual flight test, the effectiveness of the optimization algorithm in improving system stability and reducing oscillation amplitude is verified. At the same time, this study conducted a comparative analysis of the suspension system of the quadrotor vehicle and the free fall body, and the optimization algorithm is found to be feasible and can well improve the control accuracy and stability of the system, and provide strong support for the safety of the quadrotor vehicle in various application scenarios.

articleTitle: DA-Slim UNETR: A Dual Attention Enhanced Network for Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Image segmentation, a technique for classifying regions of interest at the pixel level, is essential in computer vision applications such as autonomous driving and surveillance. Slim UNETR is an efficient deep learning method for medical image segmentation, capable of processing 3D medical data to identify regions of interest, like tumors, for doctors. This network employs a U-shaped architecture and is categorized as a hybrid Transformer network, achieving high Dice accuracy for segmentation tasks. However, its skip connections inadequately extract positional and channel information from feature maps. To address this issue, we introduced DA-Black, a dual attention module that combines positional and channel attention. By integrating DA-Black, we developed DA-Slim UNETR. Slim UNETR achieved an accuracy of 80.27% on the MSD2019 Task-01. With DA-Black incorporated into the skip connections and bottleneck layers, DA-Slim UNETR’s Dice segmentation accuracy improved to 81.54%, a 1.27% increase. This performance is also 2.38% higher than the mainstream medical segmentation network Swin UNETR.

articleTitle: Hazardous Gas Concentration Monitoring in Factories Based on FTIR Combined with WOA-BP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the intensification of air pollution problems, real-time monitoring of harmful gas concentration is very important. Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR) has been widely used in the field of gas testing with its advantages of its fastness and accuracy. Standard BP neural network models will have a low accuracy and slower speed when detecting gas concentrations, so this paper uses the whale optimization algorithm to optimize the BP neural network, which will be used to detect the concentration of harmful gases in the factory. The whale optimization algorithm can avoid being in a local optimal problem during the training process, and the training speed and accuracy can be improved. This article uses the absorbance of the gas and the temperature of the current environment as the input of the system and the concentration value of the gas is used as the output. The experimental results show that the error between the gas concentration predicted by the BP neural network model and the actual value is about 6%, and the error of the WOA-BP model is about 3%. The root mean square error (RMSE) is also improved, verifying the accuracy of the WOA-BP model.

articleTitle: Uncertain Semi-parametric Additive Model Based on Orthogonal Series Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In engineering applications, uncertain nonparametric and semi-parametric regression models are of interest for effectively exploring complex correlations of imprecise data in small samples. This paper proposes a new model: the uncertain semi-parametric additive model, which incorporates multidimensional explanatory variables into the analytical process and sets both linear and nonlinear regression relationships. The parametric and nonparametric regression functions of the new model are fitted using uncertain least squares and orthogonal series methods, respectively. This paper also investigates the residual analysis, forecast value and forecast interval of the uncertain semi-parametric additive model. Finally, the validity and applicability of the proposed model and method are verified by numerical simulation of a series of small-sample observations in practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: TimeVAE-based Hypersonic Glide Vehicle Trajectory Generation Method and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: As a class of vehicles, hypersonic glide vehicles (HGVs) can reach speeds up to 20 mach and are characterized by high maneuverability. This paper deals with the problem of hypersonic glide vehicle (HGV) trajectory generation. First, considering the abilities of approximating the probability density function of a given dataset and incorporating specific temporal structures into the data generation process, we utilize TimeVAE to realize the task of trajectory generation. TimeVAE can learn the original dataset’s temporal and spatial properties well. Second, we fully study the quality of the generated dataset. “How well do the generated HGV trajectories obey the dynamic model?” and “How similar is the generated dataset to the original one?” are answered in this paper. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of TimeVAE in generating HGV trajectories through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A DOA Estimation Method for Distributed Source Based on Separation of Circular and Non circular Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In complex environments, scattering, reflection, and diffraction can cause a certain angular spread of the signal source in space, in which case a distributed source model needs to be established for the target signal source. Existing methods for calculating the direction of arrival of distributed source models in the case of circular and non-circular signals mixed together cannot expand the virtual array for circular signals, which will limit the improvement of the array aperture and degrees of freedom, and cannot distinguish the same direction distributed circular signals and non-circular signals. To solve this problem, a distributed source signal angle parameter estimation method based on separation of circular and noncircular signals is proposed. Theoretical analysis and simulation experiments show that, compared with existing algorithms, the proposed algorithm, by vectorization and signal separation and reconstruction, has higher degrees of freedom and larger array aperture, thus enabling underdetermined estimation and higher parameter estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Emotion Recognition in Hearing-impaired EEG Based on Attention Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the advancement of affective computing and computer science, there is a growing interest in emotion recognition based on electroencephalogram (EEG). In this study, we utilized facial expression images to elicit emotional responses and collected EEG data from fifteen hearing-impaired individuals and fifteen individuals with normal hearing, across five emotions (happy, neutral, sad, fear, and anger). The acquired EEG data were filtered to reduce noise interference, and then independent component analysis (ICA) was used to remove ocular artifacts as well as other noise. Power spectral density (PSD), differential entropy (DE), and wavelet entropy (WE) features were extracted from preprocessed EEG signals. For classification model, the attention residual network consisted of attention residual blocks and the structure of the residual network was adapted. Integration of attention blocks within each residual block enabled the network to selectively focus on emotional representation features extraction at different stages. Results from the experiments demonstrated that using DE as a feature for classification yielded superior performance compared to other features. The average classification accuracies were $77.6 \%$ and $82.1 \%$ for the hearing-impaired and normal subject groups respectively.

articleTitle: Lifespan-based Battery Classification towards Second-life Utilization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The second-life utilization of retired batteries can not only extend their lifespan but also help alleviate energy crises and reduce environmental pollution. Technical challenges of battery reusing arise from the inherently low consistency of the retired batteries, especially when considering the lifespan. This paper proposes a meta-learning method for lifespan-based battery clustering. We first train a convolutional neural network that can classify batteries into different groups based on their lifespan, using data from the first three cycles only. Then, instead of directly predicting the lifespan, the well-trained network is utilized to predict if the lifespans of two batteries are similar, formulating an adjacent matrix. Finally, batteries with similar lifespans can be classified into the same group with the assistance of the adjacent matrix. In this way, the network trained with fresh cells can also be used to classify the retired batteries. Experimental results on 38 batteries indicate that our method can reduce the loss-of-lifespan by at least 20% compared with the cases of using the conventional capacity-resistance method to group batteries. This study demonstrates the potential of supervised learning in battery classification, offering new solutions to enhance the second-life utilization of retired batteries.

articleTitle: Multi-Thruster Unmanned Surface Vehicle Dynamic Positioning Control Based on Optimal Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Due to the presence of multiple independently controllable water jet propulsion devices, unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) exhibit strong maneuverability and flexible control during low-speed navigation, enabling features such as pivot-turning, lateral movement, and precise positioning. In order to address the challenges faced by USV power positioning systems from external disturbances such as wind, waves, and currents, this study focuses on power positioning technology for a quad-thruster USV. Firstly, the construction of a power positioning model for a quad-thruster USV is studied. Secondly, based on the constructed USV power positioning model, a power positioning control algorithm using optimal self-adaptive disturbance rejection theory and a thrust allocation algorithm based on pseudoinverse algorithm are designed. Finally, the effectiveness of the designed power positioning control algorithm for the quad-thruster USV and its robustness against external environmental disturbances are validated through MATLAB simulation tests.

articleTitle: EEG Emotion Recognition Based on CNN+LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer science, the field of emotion recognition using electroencephalogram (EEG) is getting more and more attention. In this study, we will use CNN+LSTM method for EEG emotion recognition. After the EEG data are pre-processed accordingly, we convert the standard electrode map into corresponding rectangular mapping map and extract the differential entropy (DE) feature of four different frequency bands in the corresponding channels. After that, in feature learning and classification, CNN is used to learn frequency and spatial domain feature, and LSTM is responsible for extracting the correlation of temporal information and generating classification results. We evaluated this approach on the DEAP dataset and achieved satisfactory classification results on the emotion (95.82%) and arousal (95.96%) dimensions, respectively.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicles Cluster Division and Optimized Charging Scheduling Strategy for Coordinated Wind Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Aiming at the current lack of effective pricing strategies for electric vehicles participating in wind power consumption, a cluster partitioning and charging and discharging optimization scheduling strategy is proposed based on the regulatory potential of electric vehicles for wind power consumption. Firstly, the regulatory potential of electric vehicles is divided into two aspects, time scheduling, and spatial scheduling, to construct an overall evaluation index for electric vehicles. Secondly, based on the constructed overall evaluation indicators for electric vehicles, electric vehicles are grouped, and a dynamic time of use electricity price model based on cluster partitioning is established. Then, we will establish an objective function that minimizes the peak valley difference of power grid load and maximizes the benefits of EV users. We will also establish a visual model considering wind power consumption and EV user benefits. The proposed method was validated through simulation examples, which proved credible and effective.

Author Keywords: dynamic time of use electricity price

articleTitle: Disturbance Observer Control of Flexible Manipulators Based on Singular Perturbation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The flexible manipulators express strong nonlinear in case of rigid-elastic mode coupling, then it’s hard to gain exact control result. For this problem, singular perturbation theory was adopted to decompose the dynamics into fast and slow subsystem. Firstly, the subject solution was obtained by ignoring the fast subsystem which represented elastic mode. Secondly, the expression form of elastic motion was obtained in case of stretching time scale. The perturbation of model parameters is considered for the rigid part and the disturbance observer is designed to improve the control precision, the state feedback control method is designed for the elastic part. Finally, the simulation results validate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Recognition of Live Equipment Models in Substations Based on 3D Point Cloud Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: During the expansion and modification of substations, scenarios arise where construction equipment operates near live bodies, requiring a secure distance between the equipment and the live bodies. Semantic segmentation of point clouds of live equipment is a pivotal step in the detection and identification of live equipment, and the calculation of safety distances is predicated on the outcomes of this segmentation. This study leverages point cloud data with three-dimensional spatial information, acquired via a novel laser scanning measurement system, as the foundational data set. A PointNet++ architecture is meticulously designed to extract features from the point cloud data, thereby facilitating semantic segmentation of the point cloud data pertaining to live equipment within substations. The research findings indicate that the proposed methodology achieves a segmentation accuracy of $88.5 \%$ for the experimental point cloud data set, with an overall segmentation precision of $84.5 \%$. This approach has successfully accomplished reliable semantic segmentation of extensive multi-scale point cloud data in the context of live equipment model recognition, thereby fulfilling the analytical requirements for the identification of live equipment in substations.

articleTitle: Tissue Surface-enhanced Raman Spectroscopy Combined with Machine Learning Algorithms for Rapid Detection of Alveolar Echinococcosis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Alveolar echinococcosis (AE) remains a serious worldwide public health problem as a very harmful human tapeworm disease. Rapid and accurate diagnosis of AE is crucial for treatment and postoperative recovery. This study explored the applicability of tissue surface Raman spectroscopy (SERS) combined with machine learning for rapid AE detection. Specifically, liver tissue section samples were obtained by creating an AE mouse model and SERS spectra were acquired. Five kinds of machine learning methods were used to construct AE diagnosis model, among which the linear kernel support vector machine (SVM) model had the best classification result, and the accuracy rate reached $95.7 \%$. Then, the linear SVM model was subjected to feature significance analysis, which demonstrated that the biochemicals corresponding to the spectra of 641,716 and $1372 \mathrm{~cm}^{-1}$ might be potential biomarkers. Gaussian noise is further added to test the noise interference resistance of different machine learning algorithms, and it is found that SVM with Gaussian radial basis function (RBF) kernel function has better noise interference resistance. The results show that tissue SERS spectroscopy combined with SVM algorithm for rapid detection of AE has a promising application.

articleTitle: Research on a Novel Electric Shielding in Wireless Charging System of EVs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Wireless charging is an inevitable trend in the intelligent driving of electric vehicles (EVs). Security is the primary requirement, and electromagnetic shielding is an essential structure of the wireless charging system (WCS). Aluminum foam metal is used instead of aluminum for electrical shielding in this paper, because of its high electrical conductivity and much less dense than aluminum. First, the conductivity of three aluminum foam samples is measured and analyzed. Based on the circuit theory, the impact of the electrical shielding layer on the self inductance of the transmitting coil, the self inductance of the receiving coil, and the mutual inductance between coils were analyzed. Then the effects of aluminum foam with different conductivity and thickness on the coil parameters were analyzed. Under the condition of meeting the international electromagnetic safety standards, the influence of aluminum foam on coil parameters is similar to that of the aluminum plate, and the transmission efficiency of the system can be improved by increasing the thickness of the electrical shielding layer. The results showed in the same system, to achieve electromagnetic safety with aluminum 596.43 g, but with foam aluminum only 66.27 g, which showed using foam aluminum instead of aluminum can reduce the electric shielding weight by $89 \%$.

articleTitle: Simulation Method of Closed-Loop of High-Thrust LOX/LH2 Staged Combustion Cycle Engines Control Valve
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The High-thrust LOX/LH2 staged combustion cycle engines adopt variable thrust adjustment which can achieve the best thrust control and optimize the best carrying capacity. Based on the electromechanical servo-controlled engine thrust adjustment scheme, the closed-loop control flow regulation technology of the regulating valve is the core technology of the variable thrust regulation of the engine. The flow control of the regulating valve is to use the servo actuation system to adjust the cross-sectional area of the valve to control the entrance pressure of the regulating valve. According to the analysis of the nonlinear factors of the liquid flow test bench and the servo actuation system, the controller algorithm is designed on the basis of obtaining the equivalent model of the control system through the experimental data method, the effectiveness of the closed-loop control method is verified by the hardware-in-the-loop simulation platform.

Author Keywords: High-thrust LOX/LH2 staged combustion cycle engines

articleTitle: Two-stage Power Supply Restoration Strategy of Honeycomb Distribution Network Considering Multitype Resource Coordination
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The traditional distribution network model is difficult to effectively deal with the impact of natural disasters on the system grid and operation status. Therefore, it is imperative to improve the resiliency of urban distribution network and enhance the pre-deployment and rapid recovery ability of the system after disaster. In this paper, a two-stage power supply recovery strategy of honeycomb distribution network considering the coordination of multiple types of resources is proposed. In the pre-fault stage, a distributed mobile energy storage model is established to cope with the post-fault power supply recovery. According to the fault response characteristics of different types of distributed resources, the post-fault stage is divided into emergency power support and rapid load recovery, and the honeycomb distribution network multi-period recovery optimization model is constructed. Thus, the optimal operation of multi-type resources in honeycomb distribution network can be realized.

articleTitle: COA Optimized PEMFC Remaining Useful Life Prediction for CRJ Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Aiming at the RUL (remaining useful life) prediction problem of PEMFC (Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell), this paper proposes a PEMFC remaining service life prediction model based on the long-nosed raccoon algorithm (COA) optimized deterministic jump cycle (CRJ) network model. After smoothing the data with equal interval sampling and SG convolutional smoothing, the 24 feature variables in the original data of the PEMFC were downscaled by principal component analysis. Then optimal input features were determined by the cumulative contribution rate, and then the optimization of the CRJ network was carried out by using the optimization of the CRJ network’s cyclic ring weights $r_{c}$, jump weights $r_{j}$ and the leakage rate parameter. The optimized CRJ network was used to make a prediction of the RUL of the PEMFC. In the simulation experiments, by comparing with the unoptimized CRJ network and COA-BP network prediction model, the MAE, PMSE and $R^{2}$ of this paper’s method are better, reaching $0.0026104,0.003582$ and 0.94715, respectively.

articleTitle: Dyn-DarkSLAM: YOLO-based Visual SLAM in Low-light Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Although ORB-SLAM3 performs well on dynamic datasets after integrating with the YOLO algorithm, its high demand for lighting conditions limits its applicability in unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). To change this, we propose a novel visual off-line SLAM system called DynDarkSLAM, which significantly improves the localization and tracking performance in low-light and dynamic conditions by combining ORB-SLAM3 with GAN networks and YOLOv5. Built upon ORB-SLAM3, Dyn-DarkSLAM leverages its strong visual localization capability and integrates GAN networks to preprocess low-light images and enhance their lighting conditions, thus enhancing the system’s robustness in weak lighting environments. In addition, YOLOv5 enables real-time object detection and semantic segmentation, further expanding ORB-SLAM3’s application scope. Evaluation results on publicly available datasets with added low-light noise and publicly available 3D modeling low-light datasets demonstrate that Dyn-DarkSLAM effectively reduces trajectory errors while maintaining high computational efficiency, providing longer tracking time than existing methods in extremely low-light conditions. These characteristics make Dyn-DarkSLAM an ideal choice for applications such as autonomous drone patrols.

articleTitle: Dense Mapping Method for Indoor Dynamic Scenes Using an Improved ORB-SLAM2 Algorithm Based on RGB-D
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Leveraging instance segmentation techniques within Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) frameworks effectively tackles the challenges associated with dynamic environments. While instance segmentation algorithms enhance SLAM capabilities, it may come at the expense of real-time performance. Additionally, camera motion-induced jitter may lead to inaccurate keyframe selection and tracking loss. To address the performance bottleneck, this work introduces a novel algorithm that integrates YOLOv5 with ORB-SLAM2, aiming to achieve both real-time operation and improved localization accuracy. In the tracking thread, dynamic objects are identified and their feature points are filtered out, striking a balance between real-time performance and localization accuracy. Furthermore, a keyframe selection criterion based on inter-frame relative motion is introduced to improve the accuracy of keyframe selection. Finally, the algorithm achieves the construction of dense static point cloud maps in dynamic scenes, thereby obtaining stable dense point cloud maps. Experimental results on the walking_xyz dataset show that compared to ORBSLAM2, the proposed algorithm reduces the average processing time by $38.5 \%$ and improves the root mean square accuracy by $95.2 \%$. The experimental results indicate that compared to ORB-SLAM2, the proposed algorithm reduces the average processing time by $38.5 \%$ and improves the root mean square accuracy by $95.2 \%$ on the walking_xyz dataset. The proposed algorithm effectively addresses the aforementioned challenges, en hancing the localization accuracy and precision of SLAM algorithms, and thereby improving the usability of maps.

articleTitle: Carbon Emission Prediction of Comprehensive Industrial Parks Based on ICA Optimized ARIMAX Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Excessive carbon dioxide emissions enhance the greenhouse effect of the atmosphere, causing the temperature of the earth’s surface to continue to rise. With the growth of my country’s economy and the advancement of science and technology, the number of domestic industrial parks continues to increase, especially in the eastern coastal areas, and the scale of construction is also expanding. In order to effectively manage and reduce carbon emissions in industrial parks, it is necessary to predict and evaluate carbon emissions in industrial parks in a certain period of time in the future. Starting from the combing of the sources of carbon emissions in comprehensive industrial parks, this paper analyzes the influencing factors of carbon emissions in comprehensive industrial parks, and further uses grey correlation analysis to screen out strong correlation influencing factors. On this basis, a carbon emission prediction model for comprehensive industrial parks based on ARIMAX is established, and a large number of parameters in the model are optimized through CIA. The model is trained and compared using data from an industrial park in Tianjin. The mean square error of the proposed model is only about 5.02, which is much smaller than other models, verifying the effectiveness of the model in carbon emission prediction in comprehensive industrial parks.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of Obstacle-crossing Mechanism for Overhead Transmission Line Quality Acceptance Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: This paper proposes an obstacle-crossing mechanism for overhead transmission line quality acceptance robots. This mechanism helps robots accomplish walking and obstacle-crossing on the transmission lines. Firstly, the structural parameters of the obstacle-crossing mechanism are designed, and the process of obstacle-crossing and antiskid device are analyzed. A quasi-static force analysis of the mechanism is subsequently conducted to verify its climbing stability on transmission lines. Ultimately, the speed, acceleration, and force of the lifting legs are simulated and assessed with ADAMS, confirming the efficacy of the mechanism. The suggested obstacle-crossing mechanism effectively overcomes obstacles such as dampers and spacers, and introduces a novel design concept for robots used in the quality acceptance operation of overhead transmission lines.

articleTitle: Optimal layout design for photovoltaic shadow occlusion based on Sketchup and PVsyst
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: As photovoltaic (PV) systems gain global popularity, effectively minimizing the impact of shading on PV system performance has become a significant design challenge. This paper introduces a systematic and comprehensive shading analysis method that integrates SketchUp and PVsyst software; by utilizing SketchUp for customized 3D modeling and high-precision shading analysis, this method can effectively identify and address shading issues that are difficult to detect using traditional methods, thereby optimizing module layout and enhancing overall system performance. Subsequently, PVsyst is used to simulate and evaluate system efficiency and losses under different conditions. The aim is to improve the accuracy and efficiency of PV system design and to provide a new approach to optimizing photovoltaic system design by combining 3D modeling with performance simulation.

articleTitle: Multi-timescale Virtual Power Plant Optimization Strategy Considering Flexible Resource Real-time Schedulable Domain Characterization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the diversification of the subjects of Virtual Power Plant (VPP) aggregation topics, the requirements for exploring the flexible potential of distributed resources have increased. This paper proposes a multi-timescale VPP optimization strategy based on accurately characterizing a flexible resource schedulable domain. Firstly, a dispatch ability evaluation model for Electric Vehicles (EVs) is formulated based on the Minkowski summation, which accurately portrays the flexible adjustment range of distributed resources. The Self-Organizing Map (SOM) algorithm is used to reduce the set of scenes, so that the interests of virtual power plants and electric vehicles are balanced. Secondly, the KKT(Karush-Kuhn-Tucker) algorithm is introduced to construct the two-layer co-scheduling model for VPP and EVs, which transforms the two-layer problem into a solvable Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) problem. Finally, the model integrates Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) to evaluate the interplay between potential bid revenues and associated uncertainty risks. The actual Virtual Power Plant demonstration project of Tianjin was used to verify the accuracy and economics of the method in improving the overall profitability of the VPP.

articleTitle: Research on the On-line Calibration and Traceability Method for Underwater C-scan ACFM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The reliable and fast non-destructive testing equipment is required for the maintenance and upkeep of old underwater pipelines in the offshore oil exploration. The alternating current field measurement (ACFM) technology is the most promising technical method for solving oil transportation pipelines and critical structures on offshore platforms. In this paper, the theoretical model and simulation model for seawater environment ACFM are introduced to explore various influencing factors of measurement signal of ACFM. Then the error generation pathways of the three-axis scanning ACFM test platform are analyzed, and the error source analysis is carried out. The on-line calibration algorithm for ACFM is proposed. The ACFM C-scan detection experiment is conducted. The error in crack length detection is mostly around 5%. Compared to crack length, the calculation error of crack depth is larger, with a relative error of up to 31.82%. And the crack width calculation is with largest error because of its smallest size and the scan direction. The signal characteristics extraction method and C-scan route of crack width and depth should be improved and the simulation work need more in-depth research.

articleTitle: Adversarial Learning Based Battery Anomaly Detection in Electric Vehicle Charging Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: As a high-performance energy storage element widely used in the field of electric vehicles (EVs), the safety of lithium-ion batteries has garnered significant attention. In this study, for the EV lithium-ion battery charging mode, which produces more heat and is more dangerous, with the goal of strengthening the detection method’s efficacy and dependability and controlling the false positive rate of detection, an adversarial learning-based deep battery anomaly detection strategy is proposed to enhance the detection capability of battery anomalies. The method extracts complete charging voltage curves from normal battery historical data and uses a resampling algorithm to convert original charging curves into standard charging curves that satisfy the neural network input requirements. On this basis, a deep denoising autoencoder is used to learn the potential laws of normal battery charging curves and construct a detection model for recognizing battery charging anomalies. Finally, the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method for EV charging mode are verified based on real EV data. The proposed method controls the false positive rate within 4% on the basis of detecting all abnormal batteries.

articleTitle: Cloud Edge Collaboration-based Architecture for Offshore Floating Photovoltaic Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Affected by offshore wind and wave fluctuations, offshore photovoltaic field station data centers face problems such as low operational energy efficiency, poor interactivity, and duplicated construction of resources. It is difficult to meet the demand for control precision and accuracy of the new power system with prominent digital features. Due to the large-scale centralized access of offshore floating PV to participate in regulating offshore floating PV power station systems, the information layer must process the collected information and then form a regulation strategy to guide the optimal scheduling of the energy layer. To realize the adaptive multi-mode real-time optimization and regulation of offshore floating PV power plants, it is necessary to construct the information-energy coupling architecture of offshore floating PV power plants, which deeply integrates the optimization results of the information layer with the scheduling instructions of the energy layer. Therefore, by constructing a layered and partitioned controller architecture for offshore floating PV power plants, a cloud-side synergistic integrated control system is formed to support implementing offshore floating PV power plant technology programs. The proposed architecture’s performance in data transmission, storage, and energy consumption is analyzed through simulation. The results show that compared with the traditional centralized architecture, the construction of a layered and partitioned controller architecture for offshore floating PV power plants can save 330% of the storage capacity of the cloud servers in the big data center and reduce the energy consumption by about 22%, which verifies the validity and reasonableness of the application of the proposed architecture in the actual project.

articleTitle: Energy Storage-Based Active Support Strategy for Grid Frequency of Grid-Configured Offshore Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the new energy of large-scale grid-connected, the scale of offshore wind farms is also getting bigger and bigger. Offshore wind turbines are difficult to provide frequency support to the grid when they are fed directly via flex, and the weak grid operation capacity will be poor. Therefore, this paper proposes a grid-connected control method for offshore wind turbines based on virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology. Enable offshore wind turbines with good frequency dynamic response capability and inertia support capability. At the same time, through the configuration of energy storage devices for wind turbines to provide the energy needed to support the grid, grid-configured offshore wind turbines smoothly realize active support to assist the grid-constructing type wind turbine in providing frequency support. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control method is verified by simulation using Matlab/Simulink software.

articleTitle: A Identification Method for Indoor Fire based on KPCA-CLSSA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In order to enhance the accuracy of indoor fire recognition, this paper introduces an enhanced Sparrow Search Algorithm (CLSSA) to boost the performance of Support Vector Machines in fire recognition. The algorithm utilizes a circular chaotic mapping to enhance the initial individual quality, a Levy flight strategy to update the producer positions for improving the local extreme escape capability, and integrates dynamic adaptive weights in the follower position update to balance the local mining and global optimization search capabilities. The algorithm is employed to optimize Support Vector Machine parameters and construct a CLSSA-based Support Vector Machine classifier. Given the complexity of indoor fire data, this paper adopts Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA) for dimensionality reduction and introduces the KPCA-CLSSASVM algorithm for fire identification. The experimental results demonstrate that the algorithm’s fire recognition accuracy reaches 99% compared to Particle Swarm Optimization Support Vector Machine and other experimental models, validating the model’s accuracy and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Design and Robot Autonomous Wearing of Tactile Perception Nose Clip for Human Respiration Rate Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In order to autonomously sense the injured person’s physiological indices like respiration rate and thus take immediate robotic triage in complex disaster scenarios, a nose clip system with tactile perception was designed, and its autonomous wearing method with the help of tactile information and visual information was proposed. A test device for autonomous wearing of nose clip detection was set up. The results show that the nose clip system with tactile perception combined with the proposed wearing method can realize the autonomous detection of the nose clip with a success rate of 86.67% in the disaster scenario where visual information is missing. Compared with the traditional vision method of wearing detection, the success rate is relatively increased by 40%.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition of EEG Signals Based on CRNN+MCSNet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in emotion recognition research due to its high time resolution and ability to detect deliberately hidden emotions. Currently, all EEG based emotion recognition methods extract feature information from fixed receptor fields, which may lead to incomplete feature information extraction. Therefore, this paper proposes a CRNN+MCSNet deep network model to recognize four kinds of emotions based on EEG on multiple receptive fields. This method adaptively extracts a large number of spatial and frequency features contained in EEG through CRNN with improved network structure and learns the temporal correlation between these features. Then, these relevant features are sent to MCSNet layer to screen out important features on multiple different receptive fields. Finally, through the full connection layer and Softmax classifier, Classify and identify four kinds of emotions. The final test shows that on the DEAP data set, the average accuracy of this model for the four-emotion classification task is 89.1%, which reaches the high level of current research. Moreover, this model has a small number of parameters and a simple structure.

articleTitle: Strategy for Multi-Time-Scale Coordinated Operation of Virtual Power Plant Clusters with Electric Energy Interaction Sharing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The Virtual Power Plant (VPP) can break geographical limitations and achieve wide-area energy interconnection and sharing. To address the differences in “generation-load” resources among different VPPC within the same region and to solve the real-time power balance issues caused by the volatility of distributed renewable energy (DRE) and the uncertainty of electricity consumption behavior, a cluster service provider is introduced to manage the clusters containing various types of VPPC. Independent pricing for internal energy exchanges within the VPP cluster is implemented to incentivize VPPC to participate in coordinated dispatch. Considering the predictability of random variables and the cumulative errors that increase with decision-making time, a two-stage joint optimization model is established, which includes day-ahead coordinated dispatch and intra-day rolling optimization. The day-ahead stage focuses on the participation of multiple VPP clusters in external market transactions and internal energy exchanges, while the intra-day stage focuses on balancing VPP power to reduce deviations, forming a multitime-scale scheduling strategy for energy sharing and interaction among multiple VPPC. Finally, a simulation analysis is conducted using a multi-VPP cluster system integrating various distributed energy sources as an example. The results demonstrate that the power balance issues within the VPP cluster system are effectively improved, significantly enhancing the overall operational economy.

articleTitle: A Self-adaptive Cross Entropy Algorithm to Solve Static Weapon Target Assignment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The cross entropy algorithm can provide a suboptimal solution in solving the static weapon target assignment problem. A further improvement of the quality of the solution costs a longer computational time, making it difficult to meet the real-time requirement. In order to enhance the optimality and efficiency of cross entropy algorithm simultaneously, constraint-oriented sampling method, together with a random recombination method and dynamic sample size strategy, is designed. With combination of these improvements and basic cross entropy algorithm, a self-adaptive cross entropy algorithm is presented. Simulation results show that the self-adaptive cross entropy algorithm generates samples without violation of constraint conditions, and the sample size can be adaptively adjusted. Compared with basic cross entropy algorithm, mean fitness and computational time of the proposed method are decreased by 12.8% and 59% respectively. When compared with the exhaustive method, 69.5% of the solutions of the proposed method are optimal, and 98.6% of the solutions have a fitness deviation less than $\mathbf{1 0 \%}$ against the optimal fitness.

articleTitle: Virtual Power Plant Optimization Scheduling Considering Large-Scale New Energy Connected to the Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In the context of the current “dual-carbon” strategy, large-scale acquisition of new energy sources will greatly impact the actual power grid due to the intermittent and uncertain nature of wind and solar energy. This paper proposed a virtual power plant (VPP) optimization scheduling considering large-scale new energy connected to the power grid. Firstly, an optimal scheduling scheme for real-time balancing of VPP is established. Then, considering the power deviation compensation mechanism with the objective function of maximizing the expected net profit of the VPPs, an optimal scheduling method is obtained, which deals with the uncertainties brought by new energy and reduces the cost of deviation penalties. The proposed method reduces the bidding deviation penalties by considering the compensation mechanism for the intra-day deviation. The example results show that the model proposed in this paper improves the expected profit of the virtual power plant to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Curriculum-Guided Preference-based Reinforcement Learning: An Exploratory Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: Conveying complex objectives to reinforcement learning (RL) agents can often be difficult, involving meticulous design of reward functions that are sufficiently informative yet easy enough to provide. Human-in-the-loop RL methods allow practitioners to instead interactively teach agents through tailored feedback; however, such approaches have been challenging to scale since human feedback is very expensive. In this work, we propose a preference-based reinforcement learning method based on the idea of curriculum learning to improve the utilization of human preference feedback, namely Curriculum Guided Preference-based Reinforcement (CG-PbRL). CG-PbRL designs a difficulty metric to assess the difficulty of preference feedback queries, and learns the preference set based on the difficulty of preference queries through updating the training set, thereby training the reward estimation model from easy to difficult. Experimental results show that CG-PbRL can effectively improve the performance of preference-based reinforcement learning methods on a range of tasks.

articleTitle: An Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Network Based on Frequency Domain Information Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: The objective of infrared and visible light image fusion is to integrate data from distinct sensors to generate a more comprehensive and accurate representation of a scene. In this study, we introduce FDFusionNet, a fusion framework based on frequency domain information extraction. FDFusionNet effectively preserves thermal targets from infrared images, as well as texture structures and background details from visible images. The framework segments the extracted image features into spatial domain feature extraction and frequency domain feature extraction for enhanced performance. Fourier transform facilitates the extraction of amplitude and phase components in the frequency domain, integrating background information, while spatial domain features are extracted using SEDense. This paper achieves a balance between global and local information through the complementary nature of frequency and spatial domain features. Moreover, we incorporate information entropy to design different modal weights, effectively controlling the input ratios and suppressing redundant information and noise. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our fusion algorithm effectively balances texture and structural information, outperforming other fusion methods on the TNO public dataset. Our method consistently ranks among the top four across various evaluation metrics on TNO data, validating its superior performance in infrared and visible light fusion scenarios.

articleTitle: Load Flexibility Evaluation Method for Industrial Parks Based on SPA and TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With the requirement for an increased share of renewable energy, park load flexibility is needed to balance fluctuations between supply and demand. The factors affecting the load flexibility of the park are analyzed from four dimensions: high quality, high efficiency, security, and low carbon. The index system for evaluating the load flexibility of the park is constructed. Given the relevance of the load flexibility assessment indexes of the park, the grey entropy algorithm is improved, and the combined assignment method is proposed to enhance the assignment of the indexes’ weights. The quantitative assessment method of park flexibility is proposed based on the coupling of SPA (Set Pair Analysis) and TOPSIS (Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution). The simulation shows that this method can solve the shortcomings of traditional TOPSIS well and make the quantitative assessment results of park load flexibility more accurate, which can be a guide for evaluating the flexibility of other urban industrial parks.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Wind Farm Layout Optimization Using Bayesian Adaptive Direct Search
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: With a burgeoning global appetite for clean energy, wind energy has swiftly risen to become the second most burgeoning renewable energy source, characterized by a notable annual growth rate, and has secured a position of about 6.3% in the global energy landscape. Optimizing the layout of wind farms is critical to maximizing power generation and reducing costs, a process that involves challenges such as complex multivortex wake effects, increased design variables, and non-convex objective function spaces. To overcome these challenges, the authors propose a new optimization framework. The framework includes the analysis of the vortex wake model, the eddy deflection model and the partial eddy interference effect considering the vortex superposition effect, and transforms the wind farm layout optimization into a constrained black-box optimization problem. By merging Bayesian optimization techniques with the Mesh Adaptive Direct Search (MADS) methodology, a novel algorithm known as Bayesian Adaptive Direct Search (BADS) has been developed. As a model-independent, gradient-free, efficient sample utilization and fast convergence optimization tool, BADS can effectively solve the non-smoothness in layout optimization and avoid the local optimal trap. The results not only confirm the important role of wind farm layout in improving efficiency, but also highlight the efficiency and potential of the BADS framework in dealing with actual complex models, and provide compatibility for further integration of advanced vortex wake models and high-fidelity simulations of topographic wind field interaction, indicating that wind energy utilization will be further improved in the future.

articleTitle: Sensor Fusion SLAM: An Efficient and Robust SLAM system for Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 25th China Conference on System Simulation Technology and its Application (CCSSTA)
abstract: In response to challenges such as variable lighting conditions, sparse texture information, and dynamic, unstructured environments, this paper introduces an innovative radarvision-inertial odometry system for Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) in complex scenarios. The system integrates LiDAR, vision, and inertial sensors, capitalizing on their unique attributes to deliver high-frequency, precise pose estimation and map construction. A key component is the dynamic point cloud filtering module, which employs a fully convolutional neural network to detect, segment, and mitigate the influence of dynamic point clouds on feature matching and mapping processes. For the LiDAR inertial odometry, we propose a novel approach to point cloud feature extraction based on surface concepts, coupled with adaptive filtering and an adaptive residual algorithm. These enhancements not only improve the quality of point clouds and mapping accuracy but also conserve computational resources and bolster system robustness.
